verses.1:1: In the beginning God made heaven and the earth.
verses.1:2: Now the earth was unseen and unformed, and darkness lay over the abyss; and the Spirit of God was borne above the water.
verses.1:3: And God said, "Let light come into being"; and light came into being.
verses.1:4: And God beheld the light, that it was good; and God divided between the light and the darkness.
verses.1:5: And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And evening came, and morning came, one day.
verses.1:6: And God said, "Let a firmament come into being in the midst of the water, and let it divide between water and water." And it came to pass so.
verses.1:7: And God made the firmament, and God divided between the water which was beneath the firmament and the water which was above the firmament.
verses.1:8: And God called the firmament Heaven; and God saw that it was good. And evening came, and morning came, a second day.
verses.1:9: And God said, "Let the water which is beneath heaven be gathered together into one gathering, and let the dry land appear." And it came to pass so. And the water which was beneath heaven was gathered together into its gatherings, and the dry land appeared.
verses.1:10: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gatherings of the waters He called Seas; and God saw that it was good.
verses.1:11: And God said, "Let the earth sprout forth herbage of grass, sowing seed according to kind and according to likeness, and the fruit-bearing tree yielding fruit, whose seed is in itself according to kind for likeness upon the earth." And it came to pass so.
verses.1:12: And the earth brought forth herbage of grass, sowing seed according to kind and according to likeness, and the fruit-bearing tree yielding fruit, whose seed is in itself according to kind upon the earth. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:13: And evening came, and morning came, a third day.
verses.1:14: And God said, "Let luminaries come into being in the firmament of heaven for the lighting of the earth, and to rule the day and the night, and to divide between the day and the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and for years;
verses.1:15: and let them be for lighting in the firmament of heaven, so as to shine upon the earth." And it came to pass so.
verses.1:16: And God made the two great luminaries, the greater luminary for the rule of the day and the lesser luminary for the rule of the night, and the stars.
verses.1:17: And God set them in the firmament of heaven, so as to shine upon the earth,
verses.1:18: and to rule the day and the night, and to divide between the light and the darkness; and God saw that it was good.
verses.1:19: And evening came, and morning came, a fourth day.
verses.1:20: And God said, "Let the waters bring forth creeping things of living souls, and winged creatures flying upon the earth across the firmament of heaven." And it came to pass so.
verses.1:21: And God made the great sea creatures, and every soul of creeping animals which the waters brought forth according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to kind; and God saw that they were good.
verses.1:22: And God blessed them, saying, "Increase and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds be multiplied upon the earth."
verses.1:23: And evening came, and morning came, a fifth day.
verses.1:24: And God said, "Let the earth bring forth a living soul according to kind, four-footed beasts and creeping things and wild beasts of the earth according to kind." And it came to pass so.
verses.1:25: And God made the wild beasts of the earth according to kind, and the cattle according to kind, and all the creeping things of the earth according to their kind; and God saw that they were good.
verses.1:26: And God said, "Let Us make man according to Our image and according to likeness; and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of heaven, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over all the creeping things that creep upon the earth."
verses.1:27: And God made man; according to the image of God He made him; male and female He made them.
verses.1:28: And God blessed them, saying, "Increase and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of heaven, and over all the cattle, and over all the earth, and over all the creeping things that creep upon the earth."
verses.1:29: And God said, "Behold, I have given to you every seed-bearing herb sowing seed, which is upon all the earth, and every tree that has in itself fruit of seed for sowing; to you it shall be for food,
verses.1:30: and to all the wild beasts of the earth, and to all the birds of heaven, and to every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth, which has in itself a soul of life, even every green herb for food." And it came to pass so.
verses.1:31: And God beheld all things that He had made, and behold, they were exceedingly good. And evening came, and morning came, a sixth day.
verses.2:1: And heaven and the earth were brought to completion, and all the array of them.
verses.2:2: And God finished on the sixth day His works which He had made; and He rested on the seventh day from all His works which He had made.
verses.2:3: And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because on it He rested from all His works which God began to make.
verses.2:4: This is the book of the generation of heaven and earth, when it came into being, in the day in which the Lord God made heaven and the earth,
verses.2:5: and every green thing of the field before it came to be upon the earth, and every herb of the field before it sprang up; for God had not sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to till the earth;
verses.2:6: but a spring went up out of the earth and watered all the face of the earth.
verses.2:7: And God formed man of dust from the earth, and breathed into his face the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.2:8: And the Lord God planted a paradise in Eden toward the east, and there He placed the man whom He had formed.
verses.2:9: And God caused to spring forth yet out of the earth every tree pleasing to the sight and good for food, and the tree of life in the midst of the paradise, and the tree of knowing what is knowable of good and evil.
verses.2:10: Now a river goes forth out of Eden to water the paradise; from there it is parted into four heads.
verses.2:11: The name of the one is Pishon; this is the one that encompasses all the land of Havilah, there where the gold is;
verses.2:12: and the gold of that land is good; and there is the carbuncle and the green stone.
verses.2:13: And the name of the second river is Gihon; this is the one that encompasses all the land of Ethiopia.
verses.2:14: And the third river is Tigris; this is the one that goes over against the Assyrians. And the fourth river, this is Euphrates.
verses.2:15: And the Lord God took the man whom He had formed and placed him in the paradise, to till it and to keep it.
verses.2:16: And the Lord God commanded Adam, saying, "From every tree that is in the paradise you shall surely eat;
verses.2:17: but from the tree of knowing good and evil, you shall not eat of it; for in whatever day you eat of it, you shall surely die."
verses.2:18: And the Lord God said, "It is not good for man to be alone; let Us make for him a helper answering to him."
verses.2:19: And God formed yet out of the earth all the wild beasts of the field and all the birds of heaven, and brought them to Adam to see what he would call them; and whatever Adam called it, a living soul, that was its name.
verses.2:20: And Adam gave names to all the cattle, and to all the birds of heaven, and to all the wild beasts of the field; yet for Adam there was not found a helper like him.
verses.2:21: And God cast a trance upon Adam, and he slept; and He took one of his ribs and filled up flesh in its place.
verses.2:22: And the Lord God built the rib which He had taken from Adam into a woman, and brought her to Adam.
verses.2:23: And Adam said, "This now is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, because out of her husband she was taken."
verses.2:24: For this cause a man shall leave his father and his mother and cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh.
verses.2:25: And the two were naked, both Adam and his wife, and they were not ashamed.
verses.3:1: Now the serpent was the most shrewd of all the wild beasts upon the earth which the Lord God had made; and the serpent said to the woman, "Why is it that God has said, 'You shall by no means eat from every tree of the paradise'?"
verses.3:2: And the woman said to the serpent, "From every tree of the paradise we may eat;
verses.3:3: but from the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the paradise, God has said, 'You shall not eat of it, nor shall you touch it, lest you die.'"
verses.3:4: And the serpent said to the woman, "You shall not surely die;
verses.3:5: for God knew that in whatever day you eat of it, your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil."
verses.3:6: And the woman beheld that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasing to the eyes to look upon and fair to contemplate; and having taken of its fruit, she ate, and gave also to her husband with her, and they ate.
verses.3:7: And the eyes of the two were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made for themselves aprons.
verses.3:8: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the paradise in the cool of the afternoon; and both Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God in the midst of the tree of the paradise.
verses.3:9: And the Lord God called Adam and said to him, "Adam, where are you?"
verses.3:10: And he said to Him, "I heard Your voice as You walked in the paradise, and I was afraid, because I am naked, and I hid myself."
verses.3:11: And He said to him, "Who told you that you are naked, unless from the tree of which I commanded you, of this alone not to eat, from it you have eaten?"
verses.3:12: And Adam said, "The woman whom You gave to be with me, she gave to me from the tree, and I ate."
verses.3:13: And the Lord God said to the woman, "What is this that you have done?" And the woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
verses.3:14: And the Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, cursed are you beyond all cattle and beyond all wild beasts of the earth; upon your breast and belly you shall go, and earth you shall eat all the days of your life.
verses.3:15: And I will set enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; he shall watch for your head, and you shall watch for his heel."
verses.3:16: And to the woman He said, "Multiplying I will multiply your sorrows and your groaning; in sorrows you shall bring forth children, and toward your husband shall be your turning, and he shall rule over you."
verses.3:17: And to Adam He said, "Because you have heeded the voice of your wife, and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded you, of this alone not to eat, yet from it you have eaten, cursed is the earth in your labors; in sorrows you shall eat of it all the days of your life;
verses.3:18: thorns and thistles it shall bring forth for you, and you shall eat the herb of the field.
verses.3:19: In the sweat of your face you shall eat your bread until you return to the earth out of which you were taken; for earth you are, and to earth you shall depart."
verses.3:20: And Adam called the name of his wife Life, because she is the mother of all the living.
verses.3:21: And the Lord God made for Adam and for his wife tunics of skins, and clothed them.
verses.3:22: And the Lord God said, "Behold, Adam has become as one of Us, to know good and evil; and now, lest he stretch forth his hand and take of the tree of life and eat, and live forever—"
verses.3:23: and the Lord God sent him forth out of the paradise of delight, to till the earth out of which he was taken.
verses.3:24: And He cast Adam out and caused him to dwell over against the paradise of delight, and He stationed the cherubim and the flaming sword that turns every way, to guard the way of the tree of life.
verses.4:1: Now Adam knew his wife Eve, and she conceived and bore Cain; and she said, "I have obtained a man through God."
verses.4:2: Then again she bore his brother Abel. Now Abel became a shepherd of sheep, while Cain was tilling the ground.
verses.4:3: And it came to pass after some days that Cain brought from the fruits of the earth a sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.4:4: And Abel also brought from the firstborn of his sheep and from their fat portions. And God looked upon Abel and upon his gifts,
verses.4:5: but to Cain and to his sacrifices He gave no heed. And it grieved Cain exceedingly, and his countenance fell.
verses.4:6: Then the Lord God said to Cain, "Why have you become deeply grieved, and why has your countenance fallen?
verses.4:7: If you offer rightly, yet do not divide rightly, have you not sinned? Be still; to you shall be his turning, and you shall rule over him."
verses.4:8: And Cain said to Abel his brother, "Let us go out into the plain." And it came to pass, while they were in the plain, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and slew him.
verses.4:9: Then God said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" And he answered, "I do not know. Am I the keeper of my brother?"
verses.4:10: And God said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries out to Me from the earth.
verses.4:11: And now cursed are you upon the earth, which has opened wide its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.
verses.4:12: For you shall till the earth, and it shall not again yield its strength to you; groaning and trembling you shall be upon the earth."
verses.4:13: And Cain said to the Lord, "My guilt is too great for me to be forgiven.
verses.4:14: If You cast me out this day from the face of the earth, I shall also be hidden from Your face, and I shall be groaning and trembling upon the earth; and everyone who finds me will slay me."
verses.4:15: And the Lord God said to him, "Not so! Everyone who slays Cain shall discharge sevenfold vengeance." And the Lord God set a sign for Cain, lest anyone who found him should kill him.
verses.4:16: So Cain went out from the presence of God and dwelt in the land of Naid, opposite Eden.
verses.4:17: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Enoch. And he was building a city, and he named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.4:18: Now to Enoch was born Gaidad; and Gaidad fathered Maiel, and Maiel fathered Methuselah, and Methuselah fathered Lamech.
verses.4:19: And Lamech took for himself two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the second was Zillah.
verses.4:20: And Adah bore Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents as keepers of livestock.
verses.4:21: And his brother's name was Jubal; he was the one who introduced the harp and the lyre.
verses.4:22: And Zillah also bore Tubal; and he was a hammer-forger, a smith of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal was Naamah.
verses.4:23: Then Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, give ear to my words: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my bruising;
verses.4:24: because sevenfold vengeance has been taken for Cain, yet for Lamech seventy times seven."
verses.4:25: And Adam knew his wife Eve, and she conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Seth, saying, "For God has raised up for me another seed in place of Abel, whom Cain slew."
verses.4:26: And to Seth a son was born, and he called his name Enosh. This man hoped to call upon the name of the Lord God.
verses.5:1: This is the book of the generations of mankind. In the day that God made Adam, according to the image of God He made him;
verses.5:2: male and female He made them, and He blessed them; and He called their name Adam, in the day that He made them.
verses.5:3: Now Adam lived two hundred and thirty years, and fathered one according to his form and according to his image; and he called his name Seth.
verses.5:4: And the days of Adam after he fathered Seth were seven hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:5: So all the days of Adam that he lived were nine hundred and thirty years, and he died.
verses.5:6: Now Seth lived two hundred and five years, and fathered Enosh.
verses.5:7: And Seth lived after he fathered Enosh seven hundred and seven years, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:8: So all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.
verses.5:9: And Enosh lived one hundred and ninety years, and fathered Cainan.
verses.5:10: And Enosh lived after he fathered Cainan seven hundred and fifteen years, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:11: So all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years, and he died.
verses.5:12: And Cainan lived one hundred and seventy years, and fathered Mahalalel.
verses.5:13: And Cainan lived after he fathered Mahalalel seven hundred and forty years, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:14: So all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.
verses.5:15: And Mahalalel lived one hundred and sixty-five years, and fathered Jared.
verses.5:16: And Mahalalel lived after he fathered Jared seven hundred and thirty years, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:17: So all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.
verses.5:18: And Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years, and fathered Enoch.
verses.5:19: And Jared lived after he fathered Enoch eight hundred years, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:20: So all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.
verses.5:21: And Enoch lived one hundred and sixty-five years, and fathered Methuselah.
verses.5:22: And Enoch was well-pleasing to God after he fathered Methuselah two hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:23: So all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.
verses.5:24: And Enoch was well-pleasing to God; and he was not found, because God transferred him.
verses.5:25: And Methuselah lived one hundred and eighty-seven years, and fathered Lamech.
verses.5:26: And Methuselah lived after he fathered Lamech seven hundred and eighty-two years, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:27: So all the days of Methuselah that he lived were nine hundred and sixty-nine years, and he died.
verses.5:28: And Lamech lived one hundred and eighty-eight years, and fathered a son.
verses.5:29: And he called his name Noah, saying, "This one shall give us rest from our works and from the sorrows of our hands, and from the ground which the Lord God has cursed."
verses.5:30: And Lamech lived after he fathered Noah five hundred and sixty-five years, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:31: So all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and fifty-three years, and he died.
verses.5:32: And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.6:1: And it came to pass, when men began to grow numerous upon the earth and daughters were born to them,
verses.6:2: that the angels of God, seeing the daughters of men that they were fair, took for themselves wives from all whom they chose.
verses.6:3: And the Lord God said, "My Spirit shall by no means abide in these men forever, because they are flesh; yet their days shall be one hundred and twenty years."
verses.6:4: Now the giants were upon the earth in those days, and after that, whenever the sons of God went in to the daughters of men and they bore children to them. Those were the giants who were from of old, the men of renown.
verses.6:5: Then the Lord God saw that the evils of men were multiplied upon the earth, and that everyone meditates in his heart intently upon wicked things all the days.
verses.6:6: And God laid it to heart that He had made man upon the earth, and He pondered it.
verses.6:7: And God said, "I will blot out man whom I have made from the face of the earth, from man to livestock, and from creeping things to the birds of heaven; for I am angered that I made them."
verses.6:8: But Noah found grace before the Lord God.
verses.6:9: Now these are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, being perfect in his generation; Noah was well-pleasing to God.
verses.6:10: And Noah fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.6:11: Now the earth was corrupted before God, and the earth was filled with unrighteousness.
verses.6:12: And the Lord God saw the earth, and it was corrupted, for all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth.
verses.6:13: And God said to Noah, "The time of every man has come before Me, for the earth has been filled with unrighteousness because of them; and behold, I am destroying them and the earth.
verses.6:14: Make for yourself, therefore, an ark of squared timbers; you shall make compartments in the ark, and you shall coat it inside and outside with bitumen.
verses.6:15: And thus you shall make the ark: three hundred cubits shall be the length of the ark, and fifty cubits the breadth, and thirty cubits its height.
verses.6:16: Tapering it together you shall make the ark, and to a cubit you shall finish it at the top; and the door of the ark you shall make on the side; with lower, second, and third stories you shall make it.
verses.6:17: And behold, I Myself am bringing the flood of water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which is the spirit of life under heaven; and all things that are upon the earth shall perish.
verses.6:18: And I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall enter into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and the wives of your sons with you.
verses.6:19: And of all livestock, and of all creeping things, and of all wild beasts, and of all flesh, two by two of all you shall bring into the ark, that you may sustain them with yourself; male and female they shall be.
verses.6:20: Of all winged birds according to kind, and of all livestock according to kind, and of all creeping things that creep upon the earth according to their kind, two by two of all shall come in to you to be sustained with you, male and female.
verses.6:21: And you shall take for yourself of all foods that you shall eat, and gather them to yourself; and it shall be for you and for them to eat."
verses.6:22: And Noah did all things that the Lord God commanded him; so he did.
verses.7:1: And the Lord God said to Noah, "Enter into the ark, you and all your household, for I have seen you to be righteous before Me in this generation.
verses.7:2: Of the clean livestock bring in to yourself seven by seven, male and female; and of the livestock that are not clean, two by two, male and female;
verses.7:3: also of the clean birds of heaven seven by seven, male and female, and of all the birds that are not clean two by two, male and female, to sustain seed upon all the earth.
verses.7:4: For after seven days more I am bringing rain upon the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will blot out every living being that I have made from the face of the earth."
verses.7:5: And Noah did all things that the Lord God commanded him.
verses.7:6: Now Noah was six hundred years old, and the flood was upon the earth.
verses.7:7: And Noah, and his sons, and his wife, and the wives of his sons with him entered into the ark because of the water of the flood.
verses.7:8: And of the birds, and of the clean livestock, and of the livestock that are not clean, and of the birds, and of all the creeping things upon the earth,
verses.7:9: two by two they entered to Noah into the ark, male and female, just as God had commanded him.
verses.7:10: And it came to pass after the seven days that the water of the flood came upon the earth.
verses.7:11: In the six hundredth year of the life of Noah, in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the abyss burst forth, and the floodgates of heaven were opened;
verses.7:12: and the rain was upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
verses.7:13: On that same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and the wife of Noah and the three wives of his sons with him, entered into the ark.
verses.7:14: And all the wild beasts according to kind, and all the livestock according to kind, and every creeping thing that moves upon the earth according to kind, and every bird according to kind,
verses.7:15: entered to Noah into the ark, two by two, male and female, of all flesh in which is the spirit of life.
verses.7:16: And those that were entering, male and female of all flesh, went in just as God had commanded Noah; and the Lord God shut the ark from outside him.
verses.7:17: And the flood came upon the earth for forty days and forty nights upon the earth; and the water increased and lifted up the ark, and it was raised up from the earth.
verses.7:18: And the water prevailed and increased exceedingly upon the earth; and the ark was borne upon the water.
verses.7:19: And the water prevailed most exceedingly upon the earth, and it covered all the high mountains that were under heaven.
verses.7:20: Fifteen cubits upward the water rose, and it covered all the high mountains.
verses.7:21: And all flesh that moves upon the earth died, of birds and of livestock and of wild beasts, and every creeping thing that moves upon the earth, and every man;
verses.7:22: and all things that have the breath of life, and everyone who was upon the dry land, died.
verses.7:23: And He blotted out every living being that was upon the face of all the earth, from man to livestock, and creeping things, and the birds of heaven; and they were blotted out from the earth. And Noah alone was left, and those who were with him in the ark.
verses.7:24: And the water was raised high upon the earth for one hundred and fifty days.
verses.8:1: And God remembered Noah, and all the wild beasts, and all the livestock, and all the birds, and all the creeping things that were with him in the ark; and God brought a wind upon the earth, and the water abated;
verses.8:2: and the fountains of the abyss and the floodgates of heaven were uncovered, and the rain from heaven was restrained,
verses.8:3: and the water kept receding as it departed from the earth; the water receded and diminished after one hundred and fifty days.
verses.8:4: And the ark came to rest in the seventh month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.8:5: And the water continually diminished until the tenth month; and in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, the summits of the mountains were seen.
verses.8:6: And it came to pass after forty days that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made,
verses.8:7: and he sent out the raven to see whether the water had abated; and going out, it did not return until the water had dried up from the earth.
verses.8:8: And he sent out the dove after it, to see whether the water had abated from the earth.
verses.8:9: And the dove, finding no resting place for its feet, returned to him into the ark, for water was upon the whole face of all the earth; and stretching out his hand, he took it and brought it in to himself into the ark.
verses.8:10: And waiting yet another seven days, he again sent out the dove from the ark.
verses.8:11: And the dove returned to him toward evening, and it had a sprig of an olive leaf in its mouth; and Noah knew that the water had abated from the earth.
verses.8:12: And waiting yet another seven days, he again sent out the dove, and it did not return to him anymore.
verses.8:13: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year of the life of Noah, in the first month, on the first day of the month, that the water vanished from the earth; and Noah uncovered the roof of the ark and saw that the water had vanished from the face of the earth.
verses.8:14: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dried.
verses.8:15: And the Lord God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.8:16: "Go out from the ark, you and your wife and your sons and the wives of your sons with you,
verses.8:17: and bring out with you all the wild beasts that are with you, and all flesh from birds to livestock, and every creeping thing that moves upon the earth; and increase and multiply upon the earth."
verses.8:18: And Noah went out, and his wife, and his sons, and the wives of his sons with him;
verses.8:19: and all the wild beasts, and all the livestock, and every bird, and every creeping thing that moves upon the earth, according to their kind, went out from the ark.
verses.8:20: And Noah built an altar to God, and took of all the clean livestock and of all the clean birds, and offered up a whole burnt offering upon the altar.
verses.8:21: And the Lord God smelled a fragrance of sweet savor, and the Lord God spoke, having pondered it, "I will never again curse the earth because of the works of men, for the mind of man is intently set upon evil things from youth; therefore I will never again strike down all living flesh as I have done.
verses.8:22: All the days of the earth, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and spring shall not cease day and night."
verses.9:1: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, "Increase and multiply, and fill the earth and have dominion over it.
verses.9:2: And the dread and the fear of you shall be upon all the wild beasts of the earth, and upon all the birds of heaven, and upon all things that move upon the earth, and upon all the fish of the sea; into your hands I have given them.
verses.9:3: And every creeping thing that lives shall be for food for you; just as the green herbs, I have given all things to you.
verses.9:4: Yet flesh with the blood of life you shall not eat;
verses.9:5: for indeed, your own blood of your lives I will require; from the hand of all the wild beasts I will require it, and from the hand of a brother man I will require the life of man.
verses.9:6: Whoever sheds the blood of man, in return for his blood shall it be shed; for in the image of God I made man.
verses.9:7: But as for you, increase and multiply, and fill the earth and multiply upon the earth."
verses.9:8: And God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.9:9: "As for Me, behold, I establish My covenant with you and with your seed after you,
verses.9:10: and with every living soul that is with you—of birds and of livestock, and with all the wild beasts of the earth, as many as are with you, from all that came out of the ark.
verses.9:11: And I will establish My covenant with you: no flesh shall die anymore from the water of the flood, and there shall no longer be a flood of water to destroy all the earth."
verses.9:12: And the Lord God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant which I give between Me and you, and between every living soul that is with you, for everlasting generations:
verses.9:13: I set My bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a sign of a covenant between Me and the earth.
verses.9:14: And it shall come to pass, when I gather clouds over the earth, that My bow shall appear in the cloud;
verses.9:15: and I will remember My covenant which is between Me and you and between every living soul in all flesh; and the water shall no longer become a flood, so as to blot out all flesh.
verses.9:16: And My bow shall be in the cloud, and I will look upon it to remember an everlasting covenant between Me and every living soul in all flesh that is upon the earth."
verses.9:17: And God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant which I have made between Me and all flesh that is upon the earth."
verses.9:18: Now the sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and Ham was the father of Canaan.
verses.9:19: These three are the sons of Noah, and from them people were scattered over all the earth.
verses.9:20: And Noah began to be a man cultivating the ground, and he planted a vineyard.
verses.9:21: And he drank of the wine and became drunk, and he lay uncovered in his house.
verses.9:22: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and going out he told his two brothers outside.
verses.9:23: And Shem and Japheth took the garment, laid it upon both their backs, and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were turned backward, and they did not see the nakedness of their father.
verses.9:24: Now Noah became sober from the wine, and he knew all that his younger son had done to him.
verses.9:25: And he said, "Cursed be Canaan; a house servant shall he be to his brothers."
verses.9:26: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Shem, and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.9:27: May God enlarge Japheth, and let him dwell in the houses of Shem; and let Canaan become their servant."
verses.9:28: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.9:29: So all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years, and he died.
verses.10:1: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.
verses.10:2: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Elishah, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.10:3: And the sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.10:4: And the sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittim, and the Rhodians.
verses.10:5: From these the islands of the nations were separated in their land, each according to his tongue, in their tribes and in their nations.
verses.10:6: And the sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.10:7: And the sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.10:8: Now Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a giant upon the earth.
verses.10:9: He was a giant hunter before the Lord God; therefore they say, "Like Nimrod, a giant hunter before the Lord."
verses.10:10: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.10:11: From that land Asshur went forth, and he built Nineveh, and Rehoboth City, and Calah,
verses.10:12: and Dasem, between Nineveh and Calah; this is the great city.
verses.10:13: And Mizraim fathered the Ludim, the Nephthalim, the Anamim, and the Lehabim,
verses.10:14: and the Pathrusim and the Casluhim, from whom the Philistines came forth, and the Caphtorim.
verses.10:15: And Canaan fathered Sidon, the firstborn, and the Hittite,
verses.10:16: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.10:17: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.10:18: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. And afterward the tribes of the Canaanites were scattered abroad.
verses.10:19: And the borders of the Canaanites extended from Sidon as you go to Gerar and Gaza, as you go as far as Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, as far as Dasa.
verses.10:20: These are the sons of Ham in their tribes, according to their tongues, in their lands, and in their nations.
verses.10:21: And to Shem also children were born—the father of all the sons of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder.
verses.10:22: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.10:23: And the sons of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
verses.10:24: And Arphaxad fathered Cainan, and Cainan fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.
verses.10:25: And to Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother was Joktan.
verses.10:26: And Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.10:29: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.10:30: And their dwelling place extended from Mesha as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
verses.10:31: These are the sons of Shem in their tribes, according to their tongues, in their lands, and in their nations.
verses.10:32: These are the tribes of the sons of Noah according to their generations, according to their nations; from these the islands of the nations were scattered upon the earth after the flood.
verses.11:1: And all the earth was of one lip, and all had one voice.
verses.11:2: And it came to pass, as they moved from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and dwelt there.
verses.11:3: Then each man said to his neighbor, "Come, let us mold bricks and bake them with fire." And brick served them for stone, and asphalt was their mortar.
verses.11:4: And they said, "Come, let us build for ourselves a city and a tower whose top shall reach to heaven, and we shall make a name for ourselves, before we are scattered over the face of all the earth."
verses.11:5: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower which the sons of men had built.
verses.11:6: And the Lord said, "Behold, there is one race and one lip for all; and this they have begun to do, and now nothing shall fail them of all that they undertake to do.
verses.11:7: Come, let Us go down and confound their tongue there, so that each may not understand the voice of his neighbor."
verses.11:8: So the Lord scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they ceased building the city and the tower.
verses.11:9: Therefore its name was called Confusion, because there the Lord confounded the lips of all the earth; and from there the Lord God scattered them over the face of all the earth.
verses.11:10: Now these are the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he fathered Arphaxad, in the second year after the flood.
verses.11:11: And Shem lived five hundred years after he fathered Arphaxad, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died.
verses.11:12: And Arphaxad lived one hundred and thirty-five years, and fathered Cainan.
verses.11:13: And Arphaxad lived four hundred and thirty years after he fathered Cainan, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died. And Cainan lived one hundred and thirty years, and fathered Shelah. And Cainan lived three hundred and thirty years after he fathered Shelah, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died.
verses.11:14: And Shelah lived one hundred and thirty years, and fathered Eber.
verses.11:15: And Shelah lived three hundred and thirty years after he fathered Eber, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died.
verses.11:16: And Eber lived one hundred and thirty-four years, and fathered Peleg.
verses.11:17: And Eber lived three hundred and seventy years after he fathered Peleg, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died.
verses.11:18: And Peleg lived one hundred and thirty years, and fathered Reu.
verses.11:19: And Peleg lived two hundred and nine years after he fathered Reu, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died.
verses.11:20: And Reu lived one hundred and thirty-two years, and fathered Serug.
verses.11:21: And Reu lived two hundred and seven years after he fathered Serug, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died.
verses.11:22: And Serug lived one hundred and thirty years, and fathered Nahor.
verses.11:23: And Serug lived two hundred years after he fathered Nahor, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died.
verses.11:24: And Nahor lived seventy-nine years, and fathered Terah.
verses.11:25: And Nahor lived one hundred and twenty-nine years after he fathered Terah, and he fathered sons and daughters, and died.
verses.11:26: And Terah lived seventy years, and fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.11:27: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran fathered Lot.
verses.11:28: And Haran died in the presence of Terah his father in the land where he was born, in the country of the Chaldeans.
verses.11:29: Then Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was both the father of Milcah and the father of Iscah.
verses.11:30: Now Sarai was barren, and she did not bear children.
verses.11:31: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran, his son's son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son's wife, and brought them out from the country of the Chaldeans to go into the land of Canaan; and he came as far as Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.11:32: And the days of Terah in Haran were two hundred and five years; and Terah died in Haran.
verses.12:1: Now the Lord said to Abram, "Go forth from your land, and from your kindred, and from your father's house, to the land which I shall show you.
verses.12:2: And I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you and magnify your name, and you shall be blessed;
verses.12:3: and I will bless those who bless you, and those who curse you I will curse; and in you all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed."
verses.12:4: So Abram departed just as the Lord had spoken to him, and Lot went with him. Now Abram was seventy-five years old when he went out from Haran.
verses.12:5: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their possessions which they had acquired, and every soul whom they had acquired from Haran, and they went forth to journey into the land of Canaan; and they came into the land of Canaan.
verses.12:6: And Abram passed through its length as far as the place of Shechem, to the high oak; and the Canaanites then dwelt in the land.
verses.12:7: Then the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "To your seed I will give this land." And there Abram built an altar to the Lord, who had appeared to him.
verses.12:8: And he departed from there to the mountain east of Bethel, and pitched his tent there, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; and there he built an altar to the Lord and called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.12:9: Then Abram set out, and journeying on, he encamped in the wilderness.
verses.12:10: Now there was a famine in the land; and Abram went down to Egypt to sojourn there, for the famine grew severe in the land.
verses.12:11: And it came to pass, when Abram drew near to enter Egypt, that Abram said to Sarai his wife, "I know that you are a woman of fair countenance;
verses.12:12: therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians see you, that they will say, 'This is his wife'; and they will slay me, but you they will keep alive.
verses.12:13: Say therefore, 'I am his sister,' that it may go well with me because of you, and my soul shall live on account of you."
verses.12:14: And it came to pass, when Abram entered Egypt, that the Egyptians beheld his wife, that she was exceedingly fair,
verses.12:15: and the princes of Pharaoh saw her and praised her to Pharaoh, and they brought her in to Pharaoh.
verses.12:16: And they dealt well with Abram on her account; and he came to have sheep and calves and donkeys, menservants and maidservants, mules and camels.
verses.12:17: But God afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great and grievous afflictions concerning Sarai, the wife of Abram.
verses.12:18: Then Pharaoh called Abram and said, "What is this you have done to me, that you did not declare to me that she is your wife?
verses.12:19: Why did you say, 'She is my sister,' so that I took her to myself as a wife? Now therefore, behold, your wife is before you; take her and be gone."
verses.12:20: And Pharaoh commanded men concerning Abram to escort him away, along with his wife and all that belonged to him, and Lot with him.
verses.13:1: Then Abram went up from Egypt—he and his wife, and all that was his, and Lot with him—into the wilderness.
verses.13:2: Now Abram was exceedingly rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
verses.13:3: And he journeyed from where he had come into the wilderness as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the first, between Bethel and Ai,
verses.13:4: to the place of the altar, where he had made the tent; and there Abram called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.13:5: And Lot also, who journeyed with Abram, had sheep, and oxen, and livestock.
verses.13:6: Now the land could not contain them to dwell together, for their possessions were many, and they were not able to dwell together.
verses.13:7: And there arose strife between the herdsmen of Abram's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock; and the Canaanites and the Perizzites then dwelt in the land.
verses.13:8: Then Abram said to Lot, "Let there be no strife between me and you, nor between your herdsmen and my herdsmen, for we men are brethren.
verses.13:9: And behold, the whole land is before you; separate yourself from me. If you go to the left, I will go to the right; and if you go to the right, I will go to the left."
verses.13:10: And Lot lifted up his eyes and beheld all the surrounding region of the Jordan, that it was all well-watered—before God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah—like the paradise of God and like the land of Egypt, all the way to Zoar.
verses.13:11: So Lot chose for himself all the surrounding region of the Jordan, and Lot set out from the east; and they separated each man from his brother.
verses.13:12: Now Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, while Lot dwelt in a city of the surrounding regions and pitched his tent in Sodom.
verses.13:13: Now the men who were in Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinful before God.
verses.13:14: And God said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him, "Lift up your eyes and look from the place where you now are, to the north and south and east and west;
verses.13:15: for all the land which you see, to you I will give it and to your seed forever.
verses.13:16: And I will make your seed like the sand of the earth; if anyone is able to number the sand of the earth, then your seed also shall be numbered.
verses.13:17: Arise, walk through the land along its length and along its breadth, for to you I will give it, and to your seed forever."
verses.13:18: Then Abram moved his tent, and came and dwelt beside the oak of Mamre, which was in Hebron, and built there an altar to the Lord.
verses.14:1: Now it came to pass in the reign of Amraphel king of Shinar, that Arioch king of Ellasar, and Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Thalga king of nations,
verses.14:2: made war with Balla king of Sodom, and with Barsa king of Gomorrah, and Sennaar king of Admah, and Symobor king of Zeboiim, and with the king of Balak—this is Zoar.
verses.14:3: All these united in accord at the Salt Ravine—this is the Sea of Salt.
verses.14:4: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.14:5: And in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came, and cut down the giants in Ashtaroth Karnaim, and strong nations together with them, and the Somites in the city of Shaveh,
verses.14:6: and the Horites in the mountains of Seir, as far as the terebinth of Paran, which is in the wilderness.
verses.14:7: And turning back, they came to the Spring of Judgment—this is Kadesh—and cut down all the rulers of Amalek, and also the Amorites who dwelt in Hazazon Tamar.
verses.14:8: Then the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Balak—this is Zoar—went out and arrayed themselves for battle against them in the Salt Valley,
verses.14:9: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Thalgal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—these four kings against the five.
verses.14:10: Now the Salt Valley was filled with pits of asphalt; and the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah fled and fell there, and those who were left fled to the hill country.
verses.14:11: And he took all the cavalry of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their provisions, and they departed.
verses.14:12: And they also took Lot, the son of Abram's brother, and his belongings, and went away; for he was dwelling in Sodom.
verses.14:13: Then one of those who had escaped came and reported to Abram the migrant; now he was dwelling by the oak of Mamre the Amorite, the brother of Eshcol and the brother of Aunan, who were sworn allies of Abram.
verses.14:14: And when Abram heard that Lot his brother had been taken captive, he numbered his own homeborn servants, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued after them as far as Dan.
verses.14:15: And he fell upon them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them as far as Chobal, which is on the left of Damascus.
verses.14:16: So he brought back all the cavalry of Sodom; and he brought back Lot his brother and all his possessions, as well as the women and the people.
verses.14:17: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, to the Valley of Shaveh—this was the plain of the king.
verses.14:18: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought out loaves of bread and wine; and he was priest of God Most High.
verses.14:19: And he blessed Abram and said, "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, who created heaven and earth;
verses.14:20: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand." And he gave him a tenth of all.
verses.14:21: Then the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the men, and take the cavalry for yourself."
verses.14:22: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I will stretch out my hand to God Most High, who created heaven and earth,
verses.14:23: that I will not take from a thread to a sandal strap of all that is yours, lest you should say, 'I have made Abram rich'—
verses.14:24: except only what the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me, Eshcol, Aunan, and Mamre; these shall take a portion."
verses.15:1: Now after these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, "Do not fear, Abram; I shield you; your reward shall be exceedingly great."
verses.15:2: And Abram said, "Master, Lord, what will You give me, seeing I am departing childless, and the son of Masek my homeborn maidservant is this Damascus Eliezer?"
verses.15:3: And Abram said, "Since You have given no seed to me, indeed my homeborn servant will be my heir."
verses.15:4: And immediately the voice of the Lord came to him, saying, "This one shall not be your heir, but one who shall come forth from you, he shall be your heir."
verses.15:5: Then He brought him outside and said to him, "Look up now toward heaven and count the stars, if you are able to number them." And He said, "So shall your seed be."
verses.15:6: And Abram believed God, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness.
verses.15:7: And He said to him, "I am God, who brought you out of the land of the Chaldeans, to give you this land to inherit."
verses.15:8: And he said, "Master, Lord, by what shall I know that I will inherit it?"
verses.15:9: And He said to him, "Take for Me a three-year-old heifer, and a three-year-old goat, and a three-year-old ram, and a turtledove, and a pigeon."
verses.15:10: So he took all these for Him, and divided them down the middle, and placed them opposite one another; but he did not divide the birds.
verses.15:11: And birds came down upon the bodies, their severed halves; and Abram sat down with them.
verses.15:12: Now about sunset a trance fell upon Abram; and behold, a great dark dread fell upon him.
verses.15:13: And it was said to Abram, "Know for certain that your seed shall be a sojourner in a land not their own, and they will mistreat them, and enslave them, and afflict them four hundred years.
verses.15:14: Yet the nation whom they shall serve, I will judge; and afterward they shall come out here with abundant possessions.
verses.15:15: But you shall depart to your fathers in peace, nourished in a good old age.
verses.15:16: And in the fourth generation they shall return here, for the sins of the Amorites are not yet filled up until now."
verses.15:17: Now when the sun was near setting, a flame appeared; and behold, a smoking furnace and torches of fire, which passed through the midst of these severed halves.
verses.15:18: There God made a covenant with Abram, saying, "To your seed I will give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates:
verses.15:19: the Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kelmonites,
verses.15:20: and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaim,
verses.15:21: and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites."
verses.16:1: Now Sarai, the wife of Abram, had borne him no children; and she had an Egyptian maidservant whose name was Hagar.
verses.16:2: So Sarai said to Abram, "Behold, the Lord has shut me up from bearing children; go in therefore to my maidservant, that you may have children by her." And Abram heeded her voice.
verses.16:3: And Sarai, the wife of Abram, took Hagar the Egyptian, her maidservant, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
verses.16:4: So he went in to Hagar, and she conceived; and when she saw that she was with child, her mistress was dishonored in her sight.
verses.16:5: Then Sarai said to Abram, "I am wronged because of you! I gave my maidservant into your bosom; and when she saw that she was with child, I was dishonored in her sight. May God judge between me and you!"
verses.16:6: And Abram said to Sarai, "Behold, your maidservant is before you; deal with her as it may please you." And Sarai mistreated her, and she fled from her presence.
verses.16:7: Now the angel of the Lord God found her by the spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to Shur.
verses.16:8: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "Hagar, maidservant of Sarai, where have you come from, and where are you going?" And she said, "I am fleeing from the presence of Sarai my mistress."
verses.16:9: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "Return to your mistress, and humble yourself under her hands."
verses.16:10: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "I will exceedingly multiply your seed, and it shall not be numbered for multitude."
verses.16:11: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "Behold, you are with child, and you shall bear a son, and you shall call his name Ishmael, because the Lord has given ear to your affliction.
verses.16:12: He shall be a wild man; his hands shall be against all, and the hands of all against him, and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren."
verses.16:13: Then Hagar called the name of the Lord who spoke to her, "You are the God who looked upon me"; for she said, "Indeed, I have seen face to face Him who appeared to me."
verses.16:14: Therefore she called the well "The Well of Him Whom I Saw Face to Face"; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.16:15: So Hagar bore Abram a son; and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore to him, Ishmael.
verses.16:16: Now Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.17:1: Now Abram was ninety-nine years old, and the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "I am your God; be well-pleasing before Me, and become blameless.
verses.17:2: And I will establish My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly."
verses.17:3: And Abram fell upon his face,
verses.17:4: and God spoke to him, saying, "And as for Me, behold, My covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of a multitude of nations.
verses.17:5: And no longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham, for I have appointed you a father of many nations.
verses.17:6: And I will cause you to increase exceedingly, and I will make you into nations, and kings shall come forth from you.
verses.17:7: And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your seed after you.
verses.17:8: And I will give to you and to your seed after you the land in which you sojourn, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be God to them."
verses.17:9: And God said to Abraham, "Now as for you, you shall diligently keep My covenant, you and your seed after you throughout their generations.
verses.17:10: And this is the covenant which you shall keep, between Me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations: every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.17:11: And you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin, and it shall be for a sign of a covenant between Me and you.
verses.17:12: And a child eight days old—every male among you shall be circumcised throughout your generations: the one born in your house and the one bought with silver from any son of a foreigner, who is not of your seed,
verses.17:13: shall surely be circumcised—both the one born in your house and the one bought with silver. And My covenant shall be upon your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.17:14: And an uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin on the eighth day—that soul shall be utterly destroyed from his people, because he has broken My covenant."
verses.17:15: Then God said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, her name shall not be called Sarai, but Sarah shall be her name.
verses.17:16: And I will bless her, and I will give you a child from her; and I will bless him, and he shall become nations, and kings of nations shall come from him."
verses.17:17: Then Abraham fell upon his face and laughed, and spoke in his mind, saying, "Shall a son be born to a man one hundred years old, and shall one be born to Sarah, who is ninety years old?"
verses.17:18: And Abraham said to God, "Let this Ishmael live before You."
verses.17:19: And God said to Abraham, "Yes; behold, Sarah your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac. And I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and for his seed after him.
verses.17:20: And concerning Ishmael, behold, I have heard you, and I have blessed him, and I will cause him to increase and will multiply him exceedingly. He shall father twelve nations, and I will make him into a great nation.
verses.17:21: But My covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this time in the next year."
verses.17:22: Then He finished speaking to him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.17:23: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all those born in his house, and all those bought with silver, and every male among the men who were in the house of Abraham, and circumcised their foreskins at the time of that day, just as God had spoken to him.
verses.17:24: Now Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin;
verses.17:25: and Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.17:26: At the time of that day Abraham was circumcised, and Ishmael his son;
verses.17:27: and all the men of his house, both those born in the house and those bought with silver from foreign nations—he circumcised them.
verses.18:1: Now God appeared to him by the oak of Mamre, as he was sitting at the door of his tent at midday.
verses.18:2: And lifting up his eyes, he looked, and behold, three men were standing above him; and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the door of his tent and bowed down to the ground,
verses.18:3: and said, "Lord, if indeed I have found favor before You, do not pass by Your servant.
verses.18:4: Let water now be brought, and let someone wash your feet, and cool yourselves beneath the tree.
verses.18:5: And I will bring bread, and you shall eat; and after this you shall pass on along your way, since you have turned aside to your servant." And He said, "Do just as you have spoken."
verses.18:6: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said to her, "Hurry and knead three measures of fine flour, and make hearth cakes."
verses.18:7: And Abraham ran to the herd and took a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant, and he hastened to prepare it.
verses.18:8: Then he took butter and milk and the calf which he had prepared, and set them before them, and they ate; while he himself stood beside them under the tree.
verses.18:9: Then He said to him, "Where is Sarah your wife?" And he answered and said, "Behold, in the tent."
verses.18:10: And He said, "I will surely return to you at this time next year, and Sarah your wife shall have a son." Now Sarah was listening at the door of the tent, being behind Him.
verses.18:11: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in days; and the manner of women had ceased to be with Sarah.
verses.18:12: So Sarah laughed within herself, saying, "It has not yet happened to me until now, and my lord is old."
verses.18:13: And the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh within herself, saying, 'Shall I indeed truly bear a child, though I have grown old?'
verses.18:14: Is any matter impossible with God? At this time next year I will return to you, and Sarah shall have a son."
verses.18:15: But Sarah denied it, saying, "I did not laugh," for she was afraid. And He said, "No, but you did laugh."
verses.18:16: Then the men rose up from there and looked down toward the face of Sodom and Gomorrah, and Abraham walked along with them to escort them on their way.
verses.18:17: And the Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham My servant the things which I am doing?
verses.18:18: For Abraham shall surely become a great and numerous nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him.
verses.18:19: For I knew that he will command his sons and his house after him, and they shall keep the ways of the Lord, to do righteousness and justice, so that the Lord may bring upon Abraham all the things which He has spoken concerning him."
verses.18:20: Then the Lord said, "The outcry of Sodom and Gomorrah has been multiplied, and their sins are exceedingly great.
verses.18:21: Therefore I will go down and see whether they are acting altogether according to their outcry that comes to Me; and if not, that I may know."
verses.18:22: And the men turned away from there and went to Sodom, while Abraham was standing before the Lord.
verses.18:23: And Abraham drew near and said, "Do not destroy the righteous together with the ungodly, so that the righteous shall be as the ungodly.
verses.18:24: If there are fifty righteous in the city, will You destroy them? Will You not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous, if they are in it?
verses.18:25: By no means shall You do such a thing as this, to slay the righteous with the ungodly, so that the righteous shall be as the ungodly—by no means! You who judge all the earth, shall You not execute justice?"
verses.18:26: And the Lord said, "If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, I will spare the whole place for their sake."
verses.18:27: Then Abraham answered and said, "Now I have begun to speak to the Lord, though I am earth and ashes:
verses.18:28: if the fifty righteous should fall short by five, will You destroy the whole city on account of the five?" And He said, "I will by no means destroy it, if I find forty-five there."
verses.18:29: And he spoke to Him yet again and said, "And if forty are found there?" And He said, "I will by no means destroy it for the sake of the forty."
verses.18:30: And he said, "Do not be displeased, Lord, if I speak: what if thirty are found there?" And He said, "I will by no means destroy it, if thirty are found there."
verses.18:31: And he said, "Since I am able to speak to the Lord, what if twenty are found there?" And He said, "I will by no means destroy it for the sake of the twenty."
verses.18:32: And he said, "Do not be displeased, Lord, if I speak yet once more: what if ten are found there?" And He said, "I will by no means destroy it for the sake of the ten."
verses.18:33: So the Lord departed when He ceased speaking to Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
verses.19:1: Now the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting by the gate of Sodom. And when Lot saw them, he rose to meet them, and he bowed down with his face to the ground;
verses.19:2: and he said, "Behold, lords, turn aside to the house of your servant and lodge, and wash your feet; and rising early, you shall depart on your way." And they said, "No, rather we shall lodge in the open square."
verses.19:3: And he pressed them earnestly, and they turned aside to him. And they entered into his house; and he prepared a banquet for them and baked unleavened loaves for them, and they ate
verses.19:4: before lying down. And the men of the city, the Sodomites, surrounded the house, from young man to elder, all the people together.
verses.19:5: And they called out for Lot, and said to him, "Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may be intimate with them."
verses.19:6: And Lot went out to them, and shut the door behind him.
verses.19:7: And he said to them, "By no means, brethren, do not act wickedly.
verses.19:8: Now I have two daughters who have not known a man; I will bring them out to you, and deal with them as it pleases you; only to these men do not do anything unjust, seeing that they have come under the shelter of my beams."
verses.19:9: And they said, "Stand back over there! You came in to sojourn; would you also pass judgment? Now therefore we will harm you more than them." And they pressed hard against the man, Lot, and drew near to break down the door.
verses.19:10: But the men stretched out their hands and pulled Lot inside to themselves into the house, and shut the door of the house;
verses.19:11: and the men who were at the door of the house they struck with blindness, from small to great; and they grew exhausted searching for the door.
verses.19:12: And the men said to Lot, "Is there anyone belonging to you here—sons-in-law, or sons, or daughters, or if there is anyone else belonging to you in the city—bring them out of this place;
verses.19:13: for we are about to destroy this place, because their outcry has risen high before the Lord, and the Lord has sent us to blot it out."
verses.19:14: And Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who had taken his daughters, and said, "Arise and go out of this place, for the Lord is about to blot out the city." But he seemed to be jesting before his sons-in-law.
verses.19:15: And when dawn was coming on, the angels hurried Lot, saying, "Arise, take your wife and your two daughters whom you have, and go out, lest you perish together in the iniquities of the city."
verses.19:16: And they were troubled; and the angels took hold of their hand, and of the hand of his wife, and of the hands of his two daughters, because the Lord spared him.
verses.19:17: And it came to pass, when they had brought them outside, that they said, "Surely save your own life; do not look around behind you, nor stand still in all the surrounding region; escape to the mountain, lest you be caught up with them."
verses.19:18: And Lot said to them, "I implore you, lord,
verses.19:19: since your servant has found mercy before you, and you have magnified your righteousness, which you show toward me in keeping my soul alive—yet I shall not be able to escape safely to the mountain, lest the calamities overtake me and I die;
verses.19:20: behold, this city is near enough for me to flee there, and it is small; there I shall be saved—is it not small?—and my soul shall live on your account."
verses.19:21: And he said to him, "Behold, I have regarded your countenance in this matter also, so as not to overthrow the city concerning which you have spoken;
verses.19:22: make haste therefore to escape there; for I cannot do a thing until you arrive there." Therefore he named the name of that city Zoar.
verses.19:23: The sun had risen upon the earth, and Lot entered into Zoar,
verses.19:24: and the Lord rained upon Sodom and Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven,
verses.19:25: and He overthrew these cities in which Lot dwelt, and all the surrounding region, and all those dwelling in the cities, and all that sprang up from the earth.
verses.19:26: And his wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.19:27: Now Abraham rose early in the morning and went to the place where he had stood before the Lord,
verses.19:28: and he looked out over the face of Sodom and Gomorrah and over the face of the land of the surrounding region, and he saw; and behold, a flame of the earth was ascending like the vapor of a furnace.
verses.19:29: And it came to pass, when the Lord blotted out all the cities of the surrounding region, that God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out from the midst of the overthrow, when the Lord overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.
verses.19:30: And Lot went out of Zoar and settled in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar. And he dwelt in the cave, he and his two daughters with him.
verses.19:31: And the elder said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is no one upon the earth who will come in to us as is fitting for all the earth.
verses.19:32: Come therefore, let us give our father wine to drink and lie with him, and let us raise up seed from our father."
verses.19:33: And they gave their father wine to drink on that night; and the elder went in and lay with her father that night, and he did not know when she lay down and when she arose.
verses.19:34: And it came to pass on the next day that the elder said to the younger, "Behold, I lay yesterday with our father; let us give him wine to drink tonight also, and go in and lie with him, and let us raise up seed from our father."
verses.19:35: And they gave their father wine to drink on that night also; and the younger went in and lay with her father, and he did not know when she lay down and when she arose.
verses.19:36: And the two daughters of Lot conceived by their father.
verses.19:37: And the elder bore a son, and she called his name Moab, saying, "From my father." He is the father of the Moabites to this present day.
verses.19:38: And the younger also bore a son, and she called his name Amman, "The son of my kindred." He is the father of the Ammanites to this present day.
verses.20:1: And Abraham moved from there to the land toward the south, and he dwelt between Kadesh and Shur; and he sojourned in Gerar.
verses.20:2: And Abraham said concerning Sarah his wife, "She is my sister," for he feared to say, "She is my wife," lest the men of the city slay him on her account. And Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.
verses.20:3: And God came in to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, "Behold, you are about to die because of the woman whom you have taken, for she is married to a husband."
verses.20:4: Now Abimelech had not touched her; and he said, "Lord, will You destroy an unwitting and righteous nation?
verses.20:5: Did he not himself say to me, 'She is my sister'? And she said to me, 'He is my brother.' In a pure heart and in righteousness of hands I have done this."
verses.20:6: And God said to him in a dream, "I also knew that you did this in a pure heart, and I spared you so that you would not sin against Me; for this reason I did not permit you to touch her.
verses.20:7: Now therefore restore the wife to the man, for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for you, and you shall live. But if you do not restore her, know that you shall die, you and all that belongs to you."
verses.20:8: And Abimelech rose early in the morning and called all his servants, and spoke all these words in their ears; and all the men feared exceedingly.
verses.20:9: And Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, "What is this that you have done to us? Have we sinned in anything against you, that you have brought upon me and upon my kingdom a great sin? You have done to me a deed that no one should do."
verses.20:10: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "What did you see that you did this?"
verses.20:11: And Abraham said, "Because I said, 'Surely there is no reverence for God in this place, and they will slay me on account of my wife.'
verses.20:12: And indeed she is truly my sister, by my father, though not by my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.20:13: And it came to pass, when God brought me out from the house of my father, that I said to her, 'Show this righteousness toward me: in every place into which we may enter, say of me, "He is my brother."'"
verses.20:14: And Abimelech took a thousand didrachmas, sheep and calves, and menservants and maidservants, and gave them to Abram; and he restored to him Sarah his wife.
verses.20:15: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "Behold, my land is before you; dwell wherever it pleases you."
verses.20:16: And to Sarah he said, "Behold, I have given a thousand didrachmas to your brother; these shall be to you for the honor of your countenance and for all the women with you; and speak the truth in all things."
verses.20:17: And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants, and they bore children;
verses.20:18: for the Lord had shut up from outside every womb in the house of Abimelech on account of Sarah, Abraham's wife.
verses.21:1: And the Lord visited Sarah even as He had said; and the Lord did for Sarah according to what He had spoken.
verses.21:2: So Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham in old age, at the time just as the Lord had spoken to him.
verses.21:3: And Abraham called the name of his son who had been born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
verses.21:4: Then Abraham circumcised Isaac on the eighth day, just as God had commanded him.
verses.21:5: Now Abraham was one hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
verses.21:6: And Sarah said, "The Lord has made laughter for me; for whoever hears will rejoice with me."
verses.21:7: And she said, "Who will declare to Abraham that Sarah is nursing a child? For I have borne a son in my old age."
verses.21:8: And the child grew and was weaned; and Abraham held a great banquet on the day that his son Isaac was weaned.
verses.21:9: Now Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, who was born to Abraham, playing with her own son Isaac,
verses.21:10: and she said to Abraham, "Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of the bondwoman shall by no means inherit with my son Isaac."
verses.21:11: And the matter appeared exceedingly harsh in the sight of Abraham concerning his son Ishmael.
verses.21:12: But God said to Abraham, "Do not let the matter be harsh in your sight concerning the child and concerning the bondwoman; in all that Sarah says to you, heed her voice, for in Isaac your seed shall be called.
verses.21:13: Yet the son of this bondwoman also I will make into a great nation, because he is your seed."
verses.21:14: So Abraham rose early in the morning, and took loaves of bread and a skin of water, and gave them to Hagar; and he set them upon her shoulder, together with the child, and sent her away. And having departed, she wandered through the wilderness by the Well of the Oath.
verses.21:15: And the water ran out from the skin, and she cast the child beneath a single fir tree.
verses.21:16: Then she went away and sat down opposite him at a distance, about a bowshot off; for she said, "I will by no means look upon the death of my child." So she sat opposite him afar off; and the child cried aloud and wept.
verses.21:17: And God heard the voice of the child from the place where he was; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven and said to her, "What is it, Hagar? Do not fear, for God has heard the voice of your child from the place where he is.
verses.21:18: Arise, take up the child, and hold him fast with your hand; for I will make him into a great nation."
verses.21:19: Then God opened her eyes, and she beheld a well of living water; and she went and filled the skin with water, and gave the child to drink.
verses.21:20: And God was with the child; and he grew and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.21:21: And he dwelt in the wilderness; and his mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
verses.21:22: Now it came to pass at that time that Abimelech, and Ahuzzath his bridal escort, and Phicol the commander-in-chief of his army, spoke to Abraham, saying, "God is with you in all things that you do.
verses.21:23: Now therefore, swear to me by God that you will not deal unjustly with me, nor with my seed, nor with my name; but according to the righteousness that I have shown toward you, so you shall deal with me, and with the land in which you have sojourned."
verses.21:25: Then Abraham reproved Abimelech concerning the wells of water which the servants of Abimelech had taken away.
verses.21:26: And Abimelech said to him, "I do not know who has done this thing; neither did you tell me, nor have I heard of it except today."
verses.21:27: So Abraham took sheep and calves and gave them to Abimelech, and both of them made a covenant.
verses.21:28: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock apart by themselves.
verses.21:29: Then Abimelech said to Abraham, "What are these seven ewe lambs of the flock that you have set apart by themselves?"
verses.21:30: And Abraham said, "You shall receive these seven ewe lambs from me, that they may be for a witness that I dug this well."
verses.21:31: Therefore he called the name of that place Well of Swearing, because there both of them swore an oath.
verses.21:32: So they made a covenant at the Well of the Oath. Then Abimelech rose up, and Ahuzzath his bridal escort, and Phicol the commander-in-chief of his army, and they returned to the land of the Philistines.
verses.21:33: And Abraham planted a field at the Well of the Oath, and there he called upon the name of the Lord, Everlasting God.
verses.21:34: And Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.
verses.22:1: Now it came to pass after these things that God tested Abraham, and said to him, "Abraham, Abraham!" And he said, "Behold, here I am."
verses.22:2: And He said, "Take your beloved son whom you have loved, Isaac, and journey to the high land, and offer him up there for a whole burnt offering upon one of the mountains of which I shall tell you."
verses.22:3: So Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey; and he took with himself two young men and his son Isaac. And having split wood for a whole burnt offering, he arose and went, and came on the third day to the place of which God had told him.
verses.22:4: And Abraham lifted up his eyes and beheld the place afar off.
verses.22:5: And Abraham said to his servants, "Remain here with the donkey, and I and the lad will go on over there; and after we have worshiped, we shall return to you."
verses.22:6: Then Abraham took the wood of the whole burnt offering and laid it upon his son Isaac; and he also took the fire in his hand, and the knife, and the two of them went on together.
verses.22:7: And Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, saying, "Father!" And he said, "What is it, my child?" And he said, "Behold, the fire and the wood; where is the sheep for a whole burnt offering?"
verses.22:8: And Abraham said, "God will provide for Himself a sheep for a whole burnt offering, my child." And both of them went on together,
verses.22:9: and came to the place of which God had spoken to him. And Abraham built an altar there and laid the wood upon it; and having bound his son Isaac, he placed him upon the altar, on top of the wood.
verses.22:10: And Abraham stretched out his hand to take the knife, to slay his son.
verses.22:11: And the angel of the Lord called to him out of heaven and said to him, "Abraham, Abraham!" And he said, "Behold, here I am."
verses.22:12: And He said, "Do not lay your hand upon the lad, nor do anything to him; for now I know that you fear God, and have not spared your beloved son for My sake."
