verses.22:13: Then Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, one ram caught by its horns in a sabek bush. And Abraham went and took the ram, and offered it up for a whole burnt offering in place of his son Isaac.
verses.22:14: And Abraham called the name of that place, "The Lord Has Seen"; so that they say today, "On the mountain the Lord has appeared."
verses.22:15: Then the angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time out of heaven,
verses.22:16: saying, "By Myself I have sworn, says the Lord: because you have done this thing, and have not spared your beloved son for My sake,
verses.22:17: surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven and as the sand along the shore of the sea; and your seed shall inherit the cities of the adversaries.
verses.22:18: And in your seed all the nations shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice."
verses.22:19: So Abraham returned to his servants, and they arose and went to the Well of the Oath; and Abraham dwelt at the Well of the Oath.
verses.22:20: Now it came to pass after these things that it was reported to Abraham, saying, "Behold, Milcah also has borne sons to your brother Nahor:
verses.22:21: Ox his firstborn, and Baux his brother, and Kemuel the father of the Syrians,
verses.22:22: and Chaszad, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jeldaph, and Bethuel."
verses.22:23: And Bethuel fathered Rebekah. These eight were the sons whom Milcah bore to Nahor, the brother of Abraham.
verses.22:24: And his concubine, whose name was Reera, she also bore Tabek, and Taam, and Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.23:1: Now the life of Sarah was one hundred and twenty-seven years.
verses.23:2: And Sarah died in the city of Arbok, which is in the valley; this is Hebron in the land of Canaan. And Abraham came to lament for Sarah and to mourn.
verses.23:3: Then Abraham arose from his dead, and Abraham spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.23:4: "I am an alien and a sojourner with you; therefore give me possession of a burial place with you, and I will bury my dead there."
verses.23:5: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying,
verses.23:6: "Not so, my lord, but listen to us: you are a king from God among us. In our choicest tombs bury your dead; for none of us will withhold his tomb from you, to bury your dead there."
verses.23:7: Then Abraham rose up and bowed down to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.
verses.23:8: And Abraham spoke to them, saying, "If you have it in your soul that I should bury my dead out of my sight, listen to me, and speak for me to Ephron the son of Saar,
verses.23:9: and let him give me the double cave which belongs to him, which is in a part of his field; for its full worth in silver give it to me among you as the possession of a tomb."
verses.23:10: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the sons of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered and spoke to Abraham in the hearing of the sons of Heth and of all who entered the city, saying,
verses.23:11: "Attend to me, my lord, and listen to me: the field and the cave that is in it I give to you; in the presence of my citizens I have given it to you; bury your dead."
verses.23:12: And Abraham bowed down before the people of the land.
verses.23:13: And he spoke in the ears of Ephron before all the people of the land, "Since you are on my side, listen to me: take the silver for the field from me, and bury my dead there."
verses.23:15: "No, my lord, for I have heard: four hundred didrachmas of silver—between me and you, what could this be? As for you, bury your dead."
verses.23:16: And Abraham listened to Ephron; and Abraham rendered to Ephron the silver of which he had spoken in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred didrachmas of silver, approved by merchants.
verses.23:17: And the field of Ephron, which was at the double cave that is before Mamre—the field and the cave that was in it, and every tree that was in the field, which is within its borders all around—was established
verses.23:18: to Abraham as a possession in the presence of the sons of Heth and of all who entered the city.
verses.23:19: After these things Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the double cave of the field, which is opposite Mamre; this is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
verses.23:20: And the field and the cave that was in it were confirmed to Abraham as the possession of a burial place by the sons of Heth.
verses.24:1: And Abraham was aged, advanced in days, and the Lord blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.24:2: And Abraham said to his servant, the eldest of his household, who ruled over all that was his, "Place your hand under my thigh,
verses.24:3: and I will make you swear by the Lord, the God of heaven and of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son Isaac from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell;
verses.24:4: but you shall go to my land where I was born and to my tribe, and you shall take a wife for my son Isaac from there."
verses.24:5: And the servant said to him, "Perhaps the woman will not be willing to go back with me to this land; shall I return your son to the land from which you came out?"
verses.24:6: And Abraham said to him, "Take heed to yourself that you do not return my son there.
verses.24:7: The Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, who took me from the house of my father and from the land where I was born, who spoke to me and swore to me, saying, 'To you I will give this land, and to your seed'—He will send His angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son Isaac from there.
verses.24:8: And if the woman is not willing to go with you to this land, you shall be clear from this oath; only do not return my son there."
verses.24:9: And the servant placed his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
verses.24:10: And the servant took ten camels from the camels of his master, and of all the good things of his master with him; and he arose and journeyed to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
verses.24:11: And he made the camels lie down outside the city beside the well of water toward evening, at the time when the women who draw water go out.
verses.24:12: And he said, "O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, grant success before me today, and show mercy to my master Abraham.
verses.24:13: Behold, I stand by the spring of water, and the daughters of those who dwell in the city are coming out to draw water.
verses.24:14: And let it be that the maiden to whom I say, 'Lower your water jar that I may drink,' and she says to me, 'Drink, and I will also water your camels until they cease drinking'—she is the one You have prepared for Your servant Isaac; and by this I shall know that You have shown mercy to my master Abraham."
verses.24:15: And it came to pass, before he had finished speaking in his mind, that behold, Rebekah came out—she who was born to Bethuel, the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, the brother of Abraham—with her water jar upon her shoulders.
verses.24:16: Now the maiden was exceedingly fair in appearance; she was a virgin, and no man had known her. And she went down to the spring, filled her water jar, and came up.
verses.24:17: And the servant ran to meet her and said, "Give me a little water to drink from your water jar."
verses.24:18: And she said, "Drink, my lord." And she hastened and lowered the water jar onto her arm, and gave him drink until he ceased drinking.
verses.24:19: And she said, "I will draw water for your camels also, until all of them have drunk."
verses.24:20: And she hastened and emptied the water jar into the watering trough, and ran to the well to draw water, and drew water for all the camels.
verses.24:21: And the man observed her closely and kept silent, in order to know whether the Lord had prospered his way or not.
verses.24:22: And it came to pass, when all the camels had ceased drinking, that the man took golden earrings, each a drachma in weight, and two bracelets for her hands; their weight was ten gold pieces.
verses.24:23: And he questioned her and said, "Whose daughter are you? Tell me, is there a place with your father for us to lodge?"
verses.24:24: And she said to him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor."
verses.24:25: And she said to him, "There is both straw and much fodder with us, and a place to lodge."
verses.24:26: And the man, being well pleased, worshiped the Lord and said,
verses.24:27: "Blessed be the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken righteousness and truth from my master; as for me, the Lord has guided me prosperously to the house of my master's brother."
verses.24:28: And the girl ran and reported to her mother's house according to these words.
verses.24:29: Now Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban; and Laban ran out to the man at the spring.
verses.24:30: And it came to pass, when he saw the earrings and the bracelets on the hands of his sister, and when he heard the words of his sister Rebekah, saying, "Thus the man has spoken to me," that he came to the man as he stood by the camels at the spring.
verses.24:31: And he said to him, "Come, enter in—blessed be the Lord! Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house and a place for the camels."
verses.24:32: And the man entered into the house, and he unloaded the camels; and he gave straw and fodder to the camels, and water for his feet and for the feet of the men who were with him.
verses.24:33: And he set bread before them to eat. And he said, "I will certainly not eat until I have spoken my words." And they said, "Speak."
verses.24:34: And he said, "I am Abraham's servant.
verses.24:35: And the Lord has blessed my master exceedingly, and he has been exalted; and He has given him sheep and calves, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, camels and donkeys.
verses.24:36: And Sarah my master's wife bore one son to my master after he had grown old; and he has given him all that was his.
verses.24:37: And my master made me swear, saying, 'You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I sojourn in their land;
verses.24:38: but rather you shall go to the house of my father and to my tribe, and take a wife for my son from there.'
verses.24:39: And I said to my master, 'Perhaps the woman will not go with me.'
verses.24:40: And he said to me, 'The Lord God, before whom I have been well pleasing—He will send His angel with you and prosper your way; and you shall take a wife for my son from my tribe and from the house of my father.
verses.24:41: Then you shall be guiltless from my curse; for when you come to my tribe and they do not give her to you, then you shall be guiltless from my oath.'
verses.24:42: And having come today to the spring, I said, 'O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, if You indeed prosper my way on which I now go,
verses.24:43: behold, I stand by the spring of water, and the daughters of the men of the city will come out to draw water; and let it be that the maiden to whom I say, "Give me a little water to drink from your water jar,"
verses.24:44: and she says to me, "Drink, and I will draw water for your camels also"—she is the woman whom the Lord has prepared for His own servant Isaac; and by this I shall know that You have shown mercy to my master Abraham.'
verses.24:45: And it came to pass, before I had finished speaking in my mind, that immediately Rebekah came out with her water jar upon her shoulders, and she went down to the spring and drew water. And I said to her, 'Give me a drink.'
verses.24:46: And she hastened and lowered the water jar from herself onto her arm, and said, 'Drink, and I will water your camels also.' So I drank, and she watered my camels.
verses.24:47: And I asked her and said, 'Whose daughter are you? Tell me.' And she said, 'I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.' And I put the earrings on her and the bracelets on her hands;
verses.24:48: and being well pleased, I worshiped the Lord, and blessed the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who guided me prosperously in the way of truth, to take the daughter of my master's brother for his son.
verses.24:49: Now therefore, if you will show mercy and righteousness toward my master, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand or to the left."
verses.24:50: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, "This decree has come forth from the Lord; therefore we cannot speak against you, evil for good.
verses.24:51: Behold, Rebekah is before you; take her and depart, and let her be a wife to your master's son, even as the Lord has spoken."
verses.24:52: And it came to pass, when Abraham's servant heard these words, that he worshiped the Lord, bowing to the earth.
verses.24:53: And the servant brought out articles of silver and gold, and garments, and gave them to Rebekah; and he gave gifts to her brother and to her mother.
verses.24:54: And they ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and slept. And rising up in the morning, he said, "Send me away, that I may depart to my master."
verses.24:55: And her brothers and her mother said, "Let the maiden abide with us about ten days, and after that she shall depart."
verses.24:56: And he said to them, "Do not detain me, since the Lord has prospered my way; send me away, that I may depart to my master."
verses.24:57: And they said, "Let us call the girl and inquire at her mouth."
verses.24:58: And they called Rebekah and said to her, "Will you go with this man?" And she said, "I will go."
verses.24:59: So they sent away Rebekah their sister and her possessions, and Abraham's servant and those who were with him.
verses.24:60: And they blessed Rebekah their sister and said to her, "You are our sister; become thousands of ten thousands, and may your seed inherit the cities of the adversaries."
verses.24:61: Then Rebekah and her maidservants arose and mounted the camels, and went with the man; and the servant took Rebekah and departed.
verses.24:62: Now Isaac was walking through the wilderness by the Well of Vision; for he dwelt in the land toward the south.
verses.24:63: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field toward evening; and lifting up his eyes, he saw camels coming.
verses.24:64: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes and saw Isaac, and she leaped down from the camel.
verses.24:65: And she said to the servant, "Who is that man walking in the field to meet us?" And the servant said, "This is my master." Then she took her veil and covered herself.
verses.24:66: And the servant recounted to Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.24:67: And Isaac entered into the house of his mother and took Rebekah, and she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted concerning Sarah his mother.
verses.25:1: And Abraham again took a wife, whose name was Keturah.
verses.25:2: And she bore to him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.25:3: And Jokshan fathered Sheba, Teman, and Dedan; and the sons of Dedan were Reuel, Nabdeel, Asshurim, Datusieim, and Leummim.
verses.25:4: And the sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abira, and Thergama. All these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.25:5: And Abraham gave all his possessions to Isaac his son;
verses.25:6: and to the sons of his concubines Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son while he was still living, eastward to the land of the east.
verses.25:7: Now these are the years of the days of Abraham's life which he lived: one hundred and seventy-five years.
verses.25:8: And breathing his last, Abraham died in a good old age, an old man and full of days, and was gathered to his people.
verses.25:9: And Isaac and Ishmael, his two sons, buried him in the double cave, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which faces Mamre,
verses.25:10: the field and the cave which Abraham had purchased from the sons of Heth; there they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife.
verses.25:11: And it came to pass after Abraham died that God blessed Isaac his son; and Isaac dwelt by the Well of Vision.
verses.25:12: Now these are the generations of Ishmael the son of Abraham, whom Hagar the maidservant of Sarah bore to Abraham.
verses.25:13: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by name according to his generations: the firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth, and Kedar, and Nabdeel, and Mibsam,
verses.25:14: and Mishma, and Iduma, and Massa,
verses.25:15: and Choddan, and Tema, and Jetur, and Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.25:16: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names in their tents and in their encampments—twelve princes according to their nation.
verses.25:17: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred and thirty-seven years; and breathing his last, he died and was gathered to his kindred.
verses.25:18: And he dwelt from Havilah as far as Suel, which faces Egypt until one comes to the Assyrians; in the presence of all his brethren he dwelt.
verses.25:19: And these are the generations of Isaac the son of Abraham: Abraham fathered Isaac.
verses.25:20: Now Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian from Mesopotamia, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to himself as wife.
verses.25:21: And Isaac pleaded with the Lord concerning Rebekah his wife, because she was barren; and God listened to him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.25:22: But the children leaped within her; and she said, "If it is going to be this way with me, why is this happening to me?" So she went to inquire of the Lord.
verses.25:23: And the Lord said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples shall be separated from your belly; one people shall surpass the other people, and the greater shall serve the lesser."
verses.25:24: And the days were fulfilled for her to give birth, and behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.25:25: And the firstborn son came out ruddy, altogether shaggy like a hairy hide; and she named him Esau.
verses.25:26: And after this his brother came out, with his hand grasping the heel of Esau; and she called his name Jacob. Now Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah bore them.
verses.25:27: And the young men grew up; and Esau was a man skilled in hunting, a man of the fields, while Jacob was a guileless man, dwelling in a house.
verses.25:28: And Isaac loved Esau, because his game was food for him; but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.25:29: Now Jacob boiled a stew; and Esau came from the plain, fainting.
verses.25:30: And Esau said to Jacob, "Give me a taste of this red stew, for I am fainting." Therefore his name was called Edom.
verses.25:31: And Jacob said to Esau, "Sell to me this day your birthright."
verses.25:32: And Esau said, "Behold, I am about to die, so what is this birthright to me?"
verses.25:33: And Jacob said to him, "Swear to me this day." And he swore to him; and Esau sold the birthright to Jacob.
verses.25:34: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew; and he ate and drank, and arose and went away. Thus Esau despised the birthright.
verses.26:1: Now there came a famine upon the land, besides the former famine that happened in the time of Abraham; and Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.
verses.26:2: And the Lord appeared to him and said, "Do not go down to Egypt, but dwell in the land of which I shall tell you.
verses.26:3: And sojourn in this land, and I will be with you and bless you; for to you and to your seed I will give all this land, and I will establish My oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
verses.26:4: And I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and I will give to your seed all this land, and in your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed,
verses.26:5: because Abraham your father obeyed My voice, and kept My ordinances, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws."
verses.26:7: And the men of the place asked about Rebekah his wife, and he said, "She is my sister"; for he was afraid to say, "She is my wife," lest the men of the place should slay him on account of Rebekah, because she was fair in appearance.
verses.26:8: Now he remained there a long time; and Abimelech the king of Gerar looked through the window and saw Isaac playing with Rebekah his wife.
verses.26:9: Then Abimelech called Isaac and said to him, "Surely she is your wife! Why then did you say, 'She is my sister'?" And Isaac said to him, "Because I said, 'Lest I die on account of her.'"
verses.26:10: And Abimelech said to him, "What is this that you have done to us? One of my kindred almost lay with your wife, and you brought a sin of ignorance upon us."
verses.26:11: So Abimelech charged all his people, saying, "Everyone who touches this man or his wife shall be liable to death."
verses.26:12: And Isaac sowed in that land, and in that year he found a hundredfold harvest of barley; and the Lord blessed him.
verses.26:13: And the man was exalted, and advancing he became greater until he became exceedingly great;
verses.26:14: and he came to have flocks of sheep and herds of cattle and many tilled lands. And the Philistines envied him;
verses.26:15: and all the wells which the servants of his father had dug in the time of his father, the Philistines stopped them up and filled them with earth.
verses.26:16: And Abimelech said to Isaac, "Depart from us, for you have become far mightier than we."
verses.26:17: So Isaac departed from there and encamped in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.26:18: And Isaac dug again the wells of water which the servants of Abraham his father had dug and which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham his father died; and he named them with names according to the names which Abraham his father had named them.
verses.26:19: And the servants of Isaac dug in the valley of Gerar, and found there a well of living water.
verses.26:20: And the shepherds of Gerar quarreled with the shepherds of Isaac, claiming that the water was theirs; and he called the name of that well Injustice, because they had wronged him.
verses.26:21: Then Isaac moved on from there and dug another well; and they contended over that one also, and he named it Enmity.
verses.26:22: And moving on from there he dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it; and he named it Broad Space, saying, "Because now the Lord has made room for us and has increased us upon the earth."
verses.26:23: And he went up from there to the Well of the Oath.
verses.26:24: And the Lord appeared to him in that night and said, "I am the God of Abraham your father; do not fear, for I am with you, and I will bless you and multiply your seed for the sake of Abraham your father."
verses.26:25: And he built an altar there and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there; and there the servants of Isaac dug a well.
verses.26:26: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, along with Ahuzzath his bridal escort and Phicol the commander-in-chief of his army.
verses.26:27: And Isaac said to them, "Why have you come to me, seeing that you hated me and sent me away from you?"
verses.26:28: And they said, "We have surely seen that the Lord was with you, and we said, 'Let there be a sworn oath between us and you, and we will make a covenant with you
verses.26:29: that you will do us no harm, just as we did not abhor you, and as we treated you well and sent you away in peace.' And now you are blessed by the Lord."
verses.26:30: So he made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
verses.26:31: And rising early in the morning, they swore an oath each man to his neighbor; and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in safety.
verses.26:32: Now it came to pass on that day that the servants of Isaac arrived and reported to him concerning the well which they had dug, and they said, "We have not found water."
verses.26:33: And he called its name Oath; therefore he called the name of the city Well of Oath, to this very day.
verses.26:34: Now Esau was forty years old, and he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beer the Hittite, and Masemmath, the daughter of Elon the Hivite;
verses.26:35: and they were contentious with Isaac and Rebekah.
verses.27:1: Now it came to pass, after Isaac had grown old and his eyes had become dim so that he could not see, that he called Esau his elder son and said to him, "My son." And he said to him, "Behold, here I am."
verses.27:2: And he said, "Behold, I have grown old, and I do not know the day of my death.
verses.27:3: Now therefore, take your equipment, both the quiver and the bow, and go out into the field and hunt game for me;
verses.27:4: and make savory dishes for me such as I love, and bring them to me that I may eat, so that my soul may bless you before I die."
verses.27:5: Now Rebekah heard Isaac speaking to Esau his son. And Esau went into the field to hunt game for his father.
verses.27:6: Then Rebekah said to Jacob her younger son, "Behold, I heard your father speaking to Esau your brother, saying,
verses.27:7: 'Bring me game and make savory dishes for me, that I may eat and bless you before the Lord before I die.'
verses.27:8: Now therefore, son, listen to me just as I command you:
verses.27:9: Go to the flock and take for me from there two tender and good young goats, and I will prepare them as savory dishes for your father, such as he loves;
verses.27:10: and you shall bring them in to your father, and he shall eat, so that your father may bless you before he dies."
verses.27:11: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "Esau my brother is a hairy man, whereas I am a smooth man.
verses.27:12: Perhaps my father will feel me, and I shall be before him as one showing contempt, and I shall bring upon myself a curse and not a blessing."
verses.27:13: And his mother said to him, "Upon me be your curse, child; only obey my voice, and go and bring them to me."
verses.27:14: So he went and took them and brought them to his mother, and his mother made savory dishes just as his father loved.
verses.27:15: Then Rebekah took the fine robe of Esau her elder son, which was with her in the house, and clothed Jacob her younger son with it;
verses.27:16: and she put the skins of the young goats upon his arms and upon the bare parts of his neck;
verses.27:17: and she gave the savory dishes and the loaves of bread which she had made into the hands of Jacob her son.
verses.27:18: And he brought them in to his father, and he said, "My father." And he said, "Behold, here I am. Who are you, child?"
verses.27:19: And Jacob his son said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn; I have done just as you spoke to me. Arise, sit and eat of my game, so that your soul may bless me."
verses.27:20: And Isaac said to his son, "What is this that you have found so quickly, O child?" And he said, "That which the Lord God delivered before me."
verses.27:21: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Draw near to me, and I will feel you, child, whether you are my son Esau or not."
verses.27:22: So Jacob drew near to Isaac his father, and he felt him and said, "The voice is the voice of Jacob, yet the hands are the hands of Esau."
verses.27:23: And he did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like the hands of Esau his brother; and he blessed him.
verses.27:24: And he said, "Are you my son Esau?" And he said, "I am."
verses.27:25: And he said, "Bring it near to me, and I will eat of your game, child, so that my soul may bless you." So he brought it to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.27:26: Then Isaac his father said to him, "Draw near to me and kiss me, child."
verses.27:27: And he drew near and kissed him; and he smelled the fragrance of his garments, and blessed him and said, "Behold, the fragrance of my son is like the fragrance of a full field which the Lord has blessed.
verses.27:28: And may God give you of the dew of heaven from above, and of the fatness of the earth, and an abundance of grain and wine.
verses.27:29: And let nations serve you, and rulers shall bow down to you; and be lord of your brother, and the sons of your father shall bow down to you. He who curses you is cursed, and he who blesses you is blessed."
verses.27:30: Now it came to pass, after Isaac had finished blessing Jacob his son, and it came to pass as Jacob went out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came from his hunting.
verses.27:31: And he also made savory dishes and brought them to his father; and he said to his father, "Let my father arise and eat of his son's game, so that your soul may bless me."
verses.27:32: And Isaac his father said to him, "Who are you?" And he said, "I am your firstborn son, Esau."
verses.27:33: Then Isaac was struck with an exceedingly great dismay and said, "Who then is he who hunted game for me and brought it in to me, and I ate of all of it before you came in, and I blessed him? And let him be blessed."
verses.27:34: Now it came to pass, when Esau heard the words of Isaac his father, that Esau cried out with an exceedingly loud and bitter voice, and said, "Bless me, even me also, father!"
verses.27:35: And he said to him, "Your brother came with deceit and has taken your blessing."
verses.27:36: And he said, "Rightly was his name called Jacob, for he has supplanted me now this second time: he has taken my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing." And Esau said to his father, "Have you not reserved a blessing for me, father?"
verses.27:37: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, "If I have made him lord over you, and all his brethren I have made his household servants, and with grain and wine I have sustained him, what then shall I do for you, child?"
verses.27:38: And Esau said to Isaac his father, "Do you have only one blessing, father? Bless me, even me also, father!"
verses.27:39: Then Isaac his father answered and said to him, "Behold, of the fatness of the earth shall your dwelling be, and of the dew of heaven from above;
verses.27:40: and by your sword you shall live, and you shall serve your brother. Yet it shall come to pass that when you cast it down, you shall loosen his yoke from your neck."
verses.27:41: And Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing with which his father had blessed him; and Esau said in his mind, "Let the days of mourning for my father draw near, so that I may slay Jacob my brother."
verses.27:42: And the words of Esau her elder son were reported to Rebekah. So she sent and called Jacob her younger son and said to him, "Behold, Esau your brother threatens you, to slay you.
verses.27:43: Now therefore, child, listen to my voice: arise and flee into Mesopotamia to Laban my brother, to Haran,
verses.27:44: and dwell with him a few days, until the fury
verses.27:45: and the wrath of your brother turn away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him; then I will send and summon you from there, lest I be bereaved of both of you in one day."
verses.27:46: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am weary of my life because of the daughters of the sons of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife from the daughters of this land, of what use is life to me?"
verses.28:1: Then Isaac called Jacob and blessed him, and commanded him, saying, "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.
verses.28:2: Arise, flee into Mesopotamia of Syria to the house of Bethuel your mother's father, and take for yourself a wife from there from the daughters of Laban your mother's brother.
verses.28:3: And may my God bless you, and make you increase, and multiply you, and you shall become assemblies of nations;
verses.28:4: and may He give you the blessing of Abraham your father, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojourning, which God has given to Abraham."
verses.28:5: So Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Mesopotamia, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.28:6: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and that he had departed into Mesopotamia of Syria to take a wife for himself, and that while blessing him he had commanded him, saying, "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,"
verses.28:7: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother and had gone to Mesopotamia.
verses.28:8: And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were evil in the sight of Isaac his father;
verses.28:9: so Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, the son of Abraham, the sister of Nebaioth, as a wife in addition to his wives.
verses.28:10: Now Jacob went out from the Well of the Oath and went toward Haran.
verses.28:11: And he came upon a place and lay down there, for the sun had set; and he took one of the stones of the place and placed it at his head, and he slept in that place.
verses.28:12: And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set firmly on the earth, whose top reached to heaven; and the angels of God were ascending and descending upon it.
verses.28:13: And the Lord stood firmly upon it and said, "I am the God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac. Do not be afraid; the land upon which you sleep, to you I will give it and to your seed.
verses.28:14: And your seed shall be as the sand of the sea, and it shall spread abroad to the west, and to the south, and to the north, and to the east; and in you all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed, and in your seed.
verses.28:15: And behold, I am with you, guarding you in all the way wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land; for I will by no means forsake you until I have done all that I have spoken to you."
verses.28:16: Then Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, "The Lord is in this place, and I did not know it."
verses.28:17: And he was afraid and said, "How fearful is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven!"
verses.28:18: And Jacob rose up in the morning, and took the stone which he had placed there at his head, and set it up as a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
verses.28:19: And Jacob called the name of that place House of God; yet Oulammaus was the name of the city previously.
verses.28:20: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, "If the Lord God is with me, and guards me in this way in which I am going, and gives me bread to eat and a garment to put on,
verses.28:21: and brings me back in safety to the house of my father, then the Lord shall be my God;
verses.28:22: and this stone, which I have set up as a pillar, shall be to me a house of God; and of all that You give to me, I will surely give a tenth of them to You."
verses.29:1: And Jacob lifted up his feet and journeyed to the land of the east, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.29:2: And he looked, and behold, a well in the field; and three flocks of sheep were resting there together, for out of that well they watered the flocks, and a great stone was upon the mouth of the well.
verses.29:3: Now all the flocks were gathered there, and they would roll away the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep, and restore the stone upon the mouth of the well to its place.
verses.29:4: And Jacob said to them, "Brethren, where are you from?" And they said, "We are from Haran."
verses.29:5: And he said to them, "Do you know Laban the son of Nahor?" And they said, "We know him."
verses.29:6: Then he said to them, "Is he well?" And they said, "He is well." While he was still speaking, behold, Rachel his daughter was coming with her father's sheep, for she tended her father's sheep.
verses.29:7: And Jacob said, "Much of the day still remains; it is not yet time for the livestock to be gathered together. Water the sheep, and go and pasture them."
verses.29:8: But they said, "We will not be able until all the shepherds are gathered together and roll away the stone from the mouth of the well; then we will water the sheep."
verses.29:9: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel the daughter of Laban came with her father's sheep, for she tended her father's sheep.
verses.29:10: Now it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother's brother, that Jacob drew near and rolled away the stone from the mouth of the well, and watered the sheep of Laban, his mother's brother.
verses.29:11: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and cried out with his voice and wept.
verses.29:12: And he declared to Rachel that he was her father's kinsman, and that he was the son of Rebekah; and she ran and reported to her father according to these words.
verses.29:13: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the name of Jacob, his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, embraced him, kissed him, and brought him into his house. And he recounted to Laban all these words.
verses.29:14: And Laban said to him, "You are of my bones and of my flesh." And he remained with him a month of days.
verses.29:15: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my kinsman, you shall not serve me for nothing; tell me what your wages are."
verses.29:16: Now Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.29:17: Now the eyes of Leah were weak, but Rachel was fair in form and lovely in countenance.
verses.29:18: And Jacob loved Rachel, and he said, "I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter."
verses.29:19: And Laban said to him, "It is better for me to give her to you than for me to give her to another man; dwell with me."
verses.29:20: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel.
verses.29:21: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her."
verses.29:22: So Laban gathered together all the men of the place and made a wedding feast.
verses.29:23: And evening came, and he took Leah his daughter and brought her in to Jacob; and Jacob went in to her.
verses.29:24: And Laban gave Zilpah his maidservant to Leah his daughter to be her maidservant.
verses.29:25: Now morning came, and behold, it was Leah! And Jacob said to Laban, "What is this that you have done to me? Did I not serve you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?"
verses.29:26: And Laban said, "It is not done thus in our place, to give the younger before the elder;
verses.29:27: therefore complete her seven days, and I will give you this one also in return for the labor that you shall perform with me yet another seven years."
verses.29:28: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her seven days; and Laban gave Rachel his daughter to him as a wife.
verses.29:29: And Laban gave Bilhah his maidservant to Rachel his daughter to be her maidservant.
verses.29:30: And he went in to Rachel, and he loved Rachel more than Leah; and he served him another seven years.
verses.29:31: Now when the Lord God saw that Leah was hated, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
verses.29:32: And Leah conceived and bore a son to Jacob, and she called his name Reuben, saying, "Because the Lord has seen my humiliation; now my husband will love me."
verses.29:33: And Leah conceived again and bore a second son to Jacob, and she said, "The Lord has heard that I am hated, and has given me this one also." And she called his name Simeon.
verses.29:34: And she conceived yet again and bore a son, and she said, "At this present time my husband will be on my side, for I have borne him three sons." Therefore his name was called Levi.
verses.29:35: And conceiving yet again, she bore a son, and she said, "Now this time also I will give thanks to the Lord." Therefore she called his name Judah. And she ceased bearing.
verses.30:1: Now when Rachel saw that she had not borne children to Jacob, Rachel became envious of her sister and said to Jacob, "Give me children; otherwise I shall die."
verses.30:2: Then Jacob became angry with Rachel and said to her, "Am I in the place of God, who has deprived you of the fruit of the womb?"
verses.30:3: And Rachel said to Jacob, "Behold, my maidservant Bilhah; go in to her, and she shall bear upon my knees, that I also may obtain children through her."
verses.30:4: So she gave him her maidservant Bilhah to be his wife, and Jacob went in to her.
verses.30:5: And Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant, conceived and bore a son to Jacob.
verses.30:6: And Rachel said, "God has judged for me, and has heard my voice, and has given me a son." Therefore she called his name Dan.
verses.30:7: And Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant, conceived again and bore a second son to Jacob.
verses.30:8: And Rachel said, "God has come to my aid, and I have contended with my sister and have prevailed." And she called his name Naphtali.
verses.30:9: Now Leah saw that she had ceased bearing, and she took her maidservant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.30:10: And Jacob went in to her; and Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, conceived and bore a son to Jacob.
verses.30:11: And Leah said, "With good fortune!" And she gave him the name Gad.
verses.30:12: And Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, conceived again and once more bore a second son to Jacob.
verses.30:13: And Leah said, "Blessed am I, for all the women count me blessed!" And she called his name Asher.
verses.30:14: Now Reuben went in the days of the wheat harvest and found mandrake apples in the field, and he brought them to Leah his mother. And Rachel said to Leah, "Give me some of your son's mandrakes."
verses.30:15: And Leah said, "Is it not enough for you that you have taken my husband? Will you also take my son's mandrakes?" And Rachel said, "Not so; let him lie with you this night in exchange for your son's mandrakes."
verses.30:16: Now Jacob came in from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him and said, "You shall come in to me today, for I have hired you in exchange for my son's mandrakes." And he lay with her that night.
verses.30:17: And God heard her, and she conceived and bore a fifth son to Jacob.
verses.30:18: And Leah said, "God has given me my reward, because I gave my maidservant to my husband." And she called his name Issachar, which means Reward.
verses.30:19: And Leah conceived again and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
verses.30:20: And Leah said, "God has bestowed upon me a good gift; at this present time my husband will choose me, for I have borne him six sons." And she called his name Zebulun.
verses.30:21: And after this she bore a daughter, and she called her name Dinah. And she ceased bearing.
verses.30:22: Then God remembered Rachel, and God heard her and opened her womb.
verses.30:23: And she conceived and bore a son to Jacob. And Rachel said, "God has taken away my reproach."
verses.30:24: And she called his name Joseph, saying, "May God add to me another son."
verses.30:25: Now it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, "Send me away, that I may go to my own place and to my own land.
verses.30:26: Give me the wives and the children for whom I have served you, that I may depart; for you know the service with which I have served you."
verses.30:27: And Laban said to him, "If I have found favor in your sight, I would take an omen; for God has blessed me at your coming in.
verses.30:28: Specify your wages to me, and I will give them to you."
verses.30:29: And Jacob said to him, "You know how I have served you, and how many livestock of yours were with me.
verses.30:30: For what was before me was little, and it has increased to a multitude; and the Lord has blessed you at my foot. Now therefore, when shall I also make a house for myself?"
verses.30:31: And Laban said to him, "What shall I give you?" And Jacob said to him, "You shall give me nothing. If you will do this thing for me, I will again shepherd your sheep and keep them.
verses.30:32: Let your sheep pass by today, and separate from there every dusky sheep among the lambs and every speckled and white one among the goats; it shall be my wages.
verses.30:33: And my righteousness shall answer for me tomorrow, because my wages are before you: everything that is not speckled and marked with white among the goats, and dusky among the lambs, shall be counted as stolen with me."
verses.30:34: And Laban said to him, "Let it be according to your word."
verses.30:35: And on that day he set apart the male goats that were speckled and marked with white, and all the female goats that were speckled and marked with white, and every one that was white among them, and every one that was dusky among the lambs, and delivered them into the hand of his sons.
verses.30:36: And he set a distance of a three days' journey between them and Jacob, while Jacob shepherded the remaining sheep of Laban.
verses.30:37: Now Jacob took for himself green rods of storax, and of walnut, and of plane tree, and Jacob peeled white strips in them, stripping off the green; and the white that he had peeled appeared variegated upon the rods.
verses.30:38: And he placed the rods that he had peeled in the troughs of the watering places, so that whenever the sheep came to drink before the rods—when they came to drink—the sheep would conceive in front of the rods.
verses.30:39: And the sheep brought forth young that were marked with white, and variegated, and ash-colored speckled.
verses.30:40: And Jacob separated the lambs, and he set before the sheep a ram marked with white and every variegated one among the lambs; and he set apart flocks for himself alone, and did not mingle them with the sheep of Laban.
verses.30:41: Now it came to pass, at the time when the sheep were in heat, conceiving in the womb, that Jacob placed the rods before the sheep in the troughs, so that they might conceive by the rods.
verses.30:42: For whenever the sheep gave birth, he did not place them; thus the unmarked ones became Laban's, and the marked ones became Jacob's.
verses.30:43: And the man became exceedingly, exceedingly rich, and he came to have much livestock, and oxen, and male servants, and female servants, and camels, and donkeys.
verses.31:1: Now Jacob heard the words of the sons of Laban, saying, "Jacob has taken away all that belonged to our father, and from what belonged to our father he has acquired all this glory."
verses.31:2: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and behold, it was not toward him as yesterday and the day before.
verses.31:3: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your father and to your kindred, and I will be with you."
verses.31:4: So Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field where the flocks were,
verses.31:5: and said to them, "I see your father's countenance, that it is not with me as yesterday and the day before; yet the God of my father was with me.
verses.31:6: And you yourselves know that with all my strength I have served your father.
verses.31:7: Yet your father has defrauded me and changed my wages of the ten lambs, but God did not permit him to do me harm.
verses.31:8: If he spoke thus, 'The speckled shall be your wages,' then all the sheep would bear speckled; and if he said, 'The white shall be your wages,' then all the sheep would bear white.
verses.31:9: And God has taken away all the livestock of your father and has given them to me.
verses.31:10: And it came to pass, at the time when the sheep were conceiving, that I saw with my eyes in a dream, and behold, the he-goats and the rams mounting upon the sheep and the goats were streaked with white, and speckled, and ash-gray dappled.
verses.31:11: Then the angel of God said to me in a dream, 'Jacob, Jacob!' And I said, 'What is it?'
verses.31:12: And He said, 'Lift up your eyes and see the he-goats and the rams mounting upon the sheep and the goats, streaked with white, and speckled, and ash-gray dappled; for I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.
verses.31:13: I am the God who appeared to you in the place where you anointed a pillar to Me there and vowed a vow to Me there; now therefore arise, depart from this land, and go to the land of your birth, and I will be with you.'"
verses.31:14: Then Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, "Is there still any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
verses.31:15: Are we not reckoned by him as strangers? For he has sold us, and has utterly devoured our silver.
verses.31:16: All the riches and the glory which God has taken away from our father shall be ours and our children's; now therefore, whatever God has said to you, do."
verses.31:17: Then Jacob arose and placed his wives and his children upon the camels,
verses.31:18: and he led away all his possessions and all his goods which he had acquired in Mesopotamia, and all that was his, to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.31:19: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the idols of her father.
verses.31:20: And Jacob hid the matter from Laban the Syrian, by not telling him that he was fleeing.
verses.31:21: So he fled, he and all that was his, and crossed the river, and hastened toward the mountain of Gilead.
verses.31:22: Now it was reported to Laban the Syrian on the third day that Jacob had fled.
verses.31:23: And taking all his brethren with him, he pursued after him a journey of seven days, and overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.31:24: Now God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night and said to him, "Guard yourself, lest you ever speak evil with Jacob."
verses.31:25: So Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban stationed his brethren in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.31:26: And Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done? Why have you fled in secret, and robbed me by stealth, and led away my daughters like captives of the sword?
verses.31:27: And if you had told me, I would have sent you away with gladness and with music, with timbrels and harp.
verses.31:28: I was not counted worthy to kiss my children and my daughters; now indeed you have acted foolishly.
verses.31:29: And now my hand has power to do you harm; yet the God of your father spoke to me yesterday, saying, 'Guard yourself, lest you ever speak evil with Jacob.'
verses.31:30: Now therefore you have departed, for with great longing you have longed to go away to your father's house; yet why have you stolen my gods?"
verses.31:31: Then Jacob answered and said to Laban, "For I said, 'Lest you take away your daughters from me, and all that is mine.'"
verses.31:32: And Jacob said to him, "With whomever you find your gods, he shall not live before our brethren; recognize what of yours is with me, and take it." And he recognized nothing with him; for Jacob did not know that Rachel his wife had stolen them.
verses.31:33: Then Laban went in and searched the house of Leah, and did not find them; and going out of the house of Leah, he searched the house of Jacob and the house of the two maidservants, and did not find them; and he went also into the house of Rachel.
verses.31:34: Now Rachel had taken the idols and put them into the saddlebags of the camel, and sat upon them.
verses.31:35: And she said to her father, "Do not be displeased, lord; I cannot rise before you, for the custom of women is upon me." So Laban searched throughout the whole house, and did not find the idols.
verses.31:36: Then Jacob grew angry and contended with Laban; and Jacob answered and said to Laban, "What is my wrongdoing, and what is my sin, that you have hotly pursued after me?
verses.31:37: And since you have searched all the goods of my house, what have you found of all the goods of your house? Set it here before your brethren and my brethren, and let them judge between the two of us.
verses.31:38: These twenty years I have been with you; your sheep and your goats have not miscarried, and the rams of your sheep I have not eaten.
verses.31:39: That which was taken by wild beasts I did not bring to you; I made restitution for it myself, for thefts by day and thefts by night.
verses.31:40: By day I was scorched by the burning heat, and by the frost of the night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.
verses.31:41: These twenty years I have been in your house; I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your sheep, and you have defrauded me of my wages by ten ewe-lambs.
verses.31:42: Unless the God of my father Abraham and the Fear of Isaac had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty; God has beheld my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you yesterday."
verses.31:43: Then Laban answered and said to Jacob, "Your daughters are my daughters, and your sons are my sons, and your livestock is my livestock, and all that you see is mine; yet what can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?
verses.31:44: Now therefore, come, let us make a covenant, I and you, and it shall be for a witness between me and you." And Jacob said to him, "Behold, no one is with us; see, God is witness between me and you."
verses.31:45: Then Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
verses.31:46: And Jacob said to his brethren, "Gather stones." And they gathered stones and made a heap; and they ate and drank there upon the heap. And Laban said to him, "This heap bears witness between me and you today."
verses.31:47: And Laban called it Witness Heap, but Jacob called it Heap Bears Witness.
verses.31:48: And Laban said to Jacob, "Behold this heap and this pillar which I have set up between me and you; this heap bears witness, and this pillar bears witness." Therefore its name was called Heap Bears Witness,
verses.31:49: and The Vision, of which he said, "May God watch between me and you, because we shall depart one from another.
verses.31:50: If you afflict my daughters, if you take wives besides my daughters, see, no one is with us.
verses.31:52: For if I do not pass over to you, neither shall you pass over to me beyond this heap and this pillar for harm.
verses.31:53: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor shall judge between us." And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
verses.31:54: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain, and called his brethren, and they ate and drank, and slept on the mountain.
verses.32:1: Now Laban arose in the morning, kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them; and Laban turned back and departed to his own place.
verses.32:2: And Jacob departed on his own way; and lifting up his eyes, he saw an encampment of God encamped, and the angels of God met him.
verses.32:3: And Jacob said when he saw them, "This is an encampment of God." And he called the name of that place Encampments.
verses.32:4: Now Jacob sent messengers to Esau his brother, to the land of Seir, to the country of Edom,
verses.32:5: and he commanded them, saying, "Thus you shall speak to my lord Esau: 'Thus says your servant Jacob: I have sojourned with Laban and tarried until now;
verses.32:6: and I have acquired oxen, donkeys, sheep, male servants, and female servants; and I have sent to bring word to my lord Esau, that your servant may find favor in your sight.'"
verses.32:7: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau, and he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."
verses.32:8: Then Jacob was exceedingly afraid and was distressed; and he divided the people who were with him, and the oxen and the sheep, into two encampments.
verses.32:9: And Jacob said, "If Esau comes to the one encampment and cuts it down, then the second encampment will remain to be saved."
verses.32:10: Then Jacob said, "O God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, O Lord, who said to me, 'Hasten back to the land of your birth, and I will deal well with you,'
verses.32:11: You are sufficient for me by all the righteousness and by all the truth which You have performed for Your servant; for with my staff I crossed over this Jordan, and now I have become two encampments.
verses.32:12: Deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, for I fear him, lest he come and strike me, and the mother with the children.
verses.32:13: Yet You said, 'I will surely deal well with you, and I will make your seed like the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.'"
verses.32:14: And he slept there that night. And he took gifts from what he had brought, and sent them out to Esau his brother:
verses.32:15: two hundred female goats, twenty male goats, two hundred ewes, twenty rams,
verses.32:16: thirty nursing camels and their young, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty donkeys, and ten colts.
verses.32:17: And he delivered them by the hand of his servants, each flock by itself. And he said to his servants, "Go forward ahead of me, and put a space between flock and flock."
verses.32:18: And he commanded the first, saying, "When Esau my brother meets you and asks you, saying, 'To whom do you belong, and where are you going? And whose are these going ahead of you?'
verses.32:19: then you shall say, 'They belong to your servant Jacob; he has sent gifts to my lord Esau, and behold, he himself is behind us.'"
verses.32:20: And he commanded the first, and the second, and the third, and all who went forward behind these flocks, saying, "According to this word you shall speak to Esau when you find him,
verses.32:21: and you shall say, 'Behold, your servant Jacob is coming behind us.'" For he said, "I will appease his face with the gifts that go ahead of him, and after this I shall see his face; for perhaps he will accept my face."
verses.32:22: So the gifts went forward before him, but he himself slept that night in the encampment.
verses.32:23: Now rising up that night, he took the two wives, and the two maidservants, and his eleven children, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.32:24: And he took them and crossed over the brook, and he sent across all that belonged to him.
verses.32:25: Then Jacob was left alone, and a Man wrestled with him until morning.
verses.32:26: Now He saw that He could not prevail against him, and He touched the broad part of his thigh; and the broad part of Jacob's thigh grew numb as he wrestled with Him.
verses.32:27: And He said to him, "Let Me go, for the dawn has risen." But he said, "I will by no means let You go unless You bless me."
verses.32:28: So He said to him, "What is your name?" And he said, "Jacob."
verses.32:29: And He said to him, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name; for you have prevailed with God, and with men you shall be mighty."
verses.32:30: Then Jacob asked and said, "Declare to me Your name." And He said, "Why is it that you ask My name?" And He blessed him there.
verses.32:31: And Jacob called the name of that place Form of God, "For I have seen God face to face, and my soul has been saved."
verses.32:32: Now the sun rose upon him as he passed by the Form of God, and he himself limped upon his thigh.
verses.32:33: For on account of this the sons of Israel do not eat the sinew that grew numb, which is upon the broad part of Jacob's thigh, until this day, because He touched the broad part of Jacob's thigh, the sinew, and it grew numb.
verses.33:1: Now Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, Esau his brother was coming, he and four hundred men with him; and Jacob divided the children among Leah, and Rachel, and the two maidservants;
verses.33:2: and he placed the two maidservants and their sons first, and Leah and her children behind them, and Rachel and Joseph last.
verses.33:3: But he himself passed on ahead of them, and bowed down to the ground seven times, until he drew near to his brother.
verses.33:4: And Esau ran to meet him, and embracing him, kissed him, and fell upon his neck; and both of them wept.
verses.33:5: And looking up, he saw the women and the children, and said, "What are these to you?" And he said, "The children with whom God has shown mercy to your servant."
verses.33:6: Then the maidservants and their children drew near and bowed down;
verses.33:7: and Leah and her children drew near and bowed down; and after this Rachel and Joseph drew near and bowed down.
verses.33:8: And he said, "What are these to you—all these encampments which I have met?" And he said, "That your servant may find favor in your eyes, lord."
verses.33:9: But Esau said, "I have much, brother; let what is yours remain yours."
verses.33:10: And Jacob said, "If I have found favor in your sight, receive the gifts from my hands; for on this account I have seen your face as one might see the face of God, and you will be pleased with me.
verses.33:11: Take my blessings which I have brought to you, because God has shown mercy to me, and I have everything." And he urged him strongly, and he took them.
verses.33:12: And he said, "Let us set out and go straight ahead."
verses.33:13: But he said to him, "My lord knows that the children are quite tender, and the sheep and the cows are bearing young in my care; therefore, if I drive them hard for one day, all the livestock will die.
verses.33:14: Let my lord go on ahead before the servant, and I will gather strength along the way at the leisure of the journey before me and at the pace of the little children, until I come to my lord in Seir."
verses.33:15: And Esau said, "I will leave with you some of the people who are with me." But he said, "Why this? It is enough that I have found favor in your sight, lord."
verses.33:16: So Esau returned on that day on his way to Seir.
verses.33:17: And Jacob set out to Booths; and he made houses for himself there, and for his livestock he made booths; therefore he called the name of that place Booths.
verses.33:18: And Jacob came to Salem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Mesopotamia of Syria; and he encamped before the city.
verses.33:19: And he acquired the portion of the field where he had pitched his tent, from Hamor, the father of Shechem, for one hundred lambs;
verses.33:20: and he erected an altar there and called upon the God of Israel.
verses.34:1: Now Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to observe the daughters of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.34:2: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Horite, the ruler of the land, saw her; and he took her and lay with her, and humbled her.
verses.34:3: And he became devoted to the soul of Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and loved the maiden, and spoke to her according to the mind of the maiden.
verses.34:4: And Shechem spoke to Hamor his father, saying, "Take this young girl for me as a wife."
verses.34:5: Now Jacob heard that the son of Hamor had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field, so Jacob kept silent until they came.
verses.34:6: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
verses.34:7: And the sons of Jacob came from the field; and when they heard, the men were deeply pierced in heart, and it was exceedingly grievous to them, because Shechem had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with the daughter of Jacob; and it shall not be so.
verses.34:8: And Hamor spoke to them, saying, "Shechem my son has chosen your daughter in his soul; therefore give her to him as a wife.
verses.34:9: Intermarry with us: give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for your sons.
verses.34:10: And dwell among us, and behold, the land is broad before you; dwell and trade upon it, and acquire possessions in it."
verses.34:11: Then Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, "May I find favor before you, and whatever you say to us, we will give.
verses.34:12: Multiply the dowry exceedingly, and I will give according as you say to me; and you shall give me this girl as a wife."
verses.34:13: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit, and spoke to them, because they had defiled Dinah their sister.
verses.34:14: And Simeon and Levi, the brothers of Dinah and sons of Leah, said to them, "We will not be able to do this, to give our sister to a man who has a foreskin, for it is a reproach to us.
verses.34:15: In this we will become like you and dwell among you, if you also become as we are, in that every male among you is circumcised;
verses.34:16: then we will give our daughters to you, and from your daughters we will take wives for ourselves; and we will dwell with you, and we will be as one kindred.
verses.34:17: But if you do not listen to us to be circumcised, we will take our daughters and depart."
verses.34:18: And the words were pleasing before Hamor and before Shechem the son of Hamor.
verses.34:19: And the young man did not delay to do this thing, for he was deeply attached to the daughter of Jacob; and he was the most honored of all those in the house of his father.
verses.34:20: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke to the men of their city, saying,
verses.34:21: "These men are peaceful with us; let them dwell upon the land and trade in it, and behold, the land is broad before them. We will take their daughters for ourselves as wives, and we will give our daughters to them.
verses.34:22: Only in this will the men become like us to dwell with us, so as to be one people: in that every male among us is circumcised, just as they also are circumcised.
verses.34:23: And will not their livestock and possessions and their four-footed beasts be ours? Only in this let us become like them, and they will dwell with us."
verses.34:24: And all who went out of the gate of their city listened to Hamor and Shechem his son; and they were circumcised in the flesh of their foreskin, every male.
verses.34:25: Now it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, that the two sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, the brothers of Dinah, each took his sword and entered into the city securely, and slew every male.
verses.34:26: And they slew both Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of the house of Shechem, and went out.
verses.34:27: And the sons of Jacob came upon the wounded, and plundered the city in which they had defiled Dinah their sister.
verses.34:28: And their sheep and their oxen and their donkeys, both all that was in the city and all that was in the field, they took.
verses.34:29: And all their persons and all their household goods and their wives they took captive; and they plundered both all that was in the city and all that was in the houses.
verses.34:30: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have made me hateful, so that I am evil to the inhabitants of the land, both among the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and I am few in number, and gathering together against me they will strike me down, and I will be destroyed, I and my house."
verses.34:31: And they said, "But should they treat our sister like a harlot?"
verses.35:1: Now God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to the place Bethel, and dwell there; and make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother."
verses.35:2: And Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Take away the foreign gods from your midst, and purify yourselves, and change your garments;
verses.35:3: and let us arise and go up to Bethel, and let us make there an altar to God, who heard me in the day of affliction, who was with me and preserved me safely in the way in which I went."
verses.35:4: So they gave to Jacob the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them beneath the terebinth which is in Shechem, and destroyed them until this day.
verses.35:5: And Israel departed from Shechem; and the fear of God came upon the cities round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Israel.
verses.35:6: And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, which is Bethel, he and all the people who were with him.
verses.35:7: And he built an altar there, and called the name of the place Bethel, for there God appeared to him when he fled from the face of Esau his brother.
verses.35:8: Now Deborah, the nurse of Rebekah, died below Bethel beneath the oak; and Jacob called its name Oak of Mourning.
verses.35:9: And God appeared to Jacob again in Luz, when he arrived from Mesopotamia of Syria, and God blessed him.
verses.35:10: And God said to him, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name."
verses.35:11: And God said to him, "I am your God; increase and multiply, and nations and assemblies of nations shall come from you, and kings shall go forth from your loins.
verses.35:12: And the land which I have given to Abraham and Isaac, to you I have given it; and to your seed after you I will give this land."
verses.35:13: Then God went up from him from the place where He had spoken with him.
verses.35:14: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He had spoken with him, a pillar of stone; and he poured out a drink offering upon it, and poured oil upon it.
verses.35:15: And Jacob called the name of the place in which God had spoken with him there, Bethel.
verses.35:16: Now Jacob departed from Bethel and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Gader. And it came to pass when he drew near to Chabratha to enter the land of Ephrathah, that Rachel gave birth, and she had hard labor in childbirth.
verses.35:17: And it came to pass, as she was in hard labor in giving birth, that the midwife said to her, "Take courage, for this one also is a son."
verses.35:18: And it came to pass, as she was yielding up her soul—for she was dying—that she called his name Son of my sorrow; but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.35:19: So Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrathah; this is Bethlehem.
verses.35:20: And Jacob set up a pillar over her tomb; this is the pillar of the tomb of Rachel to this day.
verses.35:22: And it came to pass when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine; and Israel heard, and it appeared evil before him. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.35:23: the sons of Leah: the firstborn of Jacob, Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun;
verses.35:24: and the sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;
verses.35:25: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant: Dan and Naphtali;
verses.35:26: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah's maidservant: Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Mesopotamia of Syria.
verses.35:27: And Jacob came to Isaac his father to Mamre, to the city of the plain—this is Hebron—in the land of Canaan, where Abraham and Isaac had sojourned.
verses.35:28: Now the days of Isaac which he lived were one hundred and eighty years.
verses.35:29: And expiring, he died and was gathered to his kindred, old and full of days; and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.
verses.36:1: Now these are the generations of Esau; he is Edom.
verses.36:2: And Esau took wives for himself from the daughters of the Canaanites: Adah, the daughter of Elom the Hittite, and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah the son of Zibeon the Hivite,
verses.36:3: and Basemath, the daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.36:4: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel,
verses.36:5: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.36:6: And Esau took his wives, his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his household, and all his possessions and his livestock, and all that he had acquired and all that he had gained in the land of Canaan; and he departed from the land of Canaan away from the presence of his brother Jacob.
verses.36:7: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their sojourning could not sustain them because of the multitude of their possessions.
verses.36:8: So Esau dwelt in Mount Seir; Esau himself is Edom.
verses.36:9: Now these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom, in Mount Seir.
verses.36:10: And these are the names of the sons of Esau: Eliphaz, the son of Adah the wife of Esau, and Reuel, the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.
verses.36:11: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Oman, Sophar, Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.36:12: Now Timna was the concubine of Eliphaz, the son of Esau, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Adah, the wife of Esau.
verses.36:13: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahom, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Masemath, the wife of Esau.
verses.36:14: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah the son of Zibeon, the wife of Esau; and she bore to Esau Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.
verses.36:15: These are the chiefs of the son of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau: Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Sophar, Chief Kenaz,
verses.36:16: Chief Korah, Chief Gotha, Chief Amalek. These are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Idumea; these are the sons of Adah.
verses.36:17: And these are the sons of Reuel, the son of Esau: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Mizzah, Chief Shammah. These are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Masemath, the wife of Esau.
verses.36:18: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, the wife of Esau: Chief Jeul, Chief Jalam, Chief Korah. These are the chiefs of Oholibamah.
verses.36:19: And these are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs; these are their chiefs, the sons of Edom.
verses.36:20: Now these are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.36:21: and Dishon, and Saar, and Rison. These are the chiefs of the Horite, the son of Seir, in the land of Edom.
verses.36:22: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Heman; and the sister of Lotan was Timna.
verses.36:23: And these are the sons of Shobal: Golon, and Manahath, and Ebal, Soph, and Oman.
verses.36:24: And these are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Onan. This is the Onas who found Jamin in the wilderness when he was pasturing the beasts of burden of his father Zibeon.
verses.36:25: And these are the sons of Anah: Dishon, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.36:26: And these are the sons of Dishon: Hamada, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.36:27: And these are the sons of Saar: Bilhan, and Zukam, and Joukam, and Ukan.
verses.36:28: And these are the sons of Rison: Uz and Aram.
verses.36:29: These are the chiefs of Hori: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,
verses.36:30: Chief Dishon, Chief Saar, Chief Rison. These are the chiefs of Hori in their chiefdoms in the land of Edom.
verses.36:31: Now these are the kings who reigned in Edom before any king reigned in Jerusalem.
verses.36:32: And Balak the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.36:33: And Balak died, and Jobad the son of Zerah, from Bozrah, reigned in his place.
verses.36:34: And Jobab died, and Husham, from the land of the Temanites, reigned in his place.
verses.36:35: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Barad, who struck down Midian in the plain of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Gethaim.
verses.36:36: And Hadad died, and Salama, from Masekka, reigned in his place.
verses.36:37: And Salama died, and Saul, from Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
verses.36:38: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.36:39: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Harath the son of Barath reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Phogor, and the name of his wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matraith the son of Mezoob.
verses.36:40: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau in their tribes, according to their place, in their lands and in their nations: Chief Timna, Chief Gola, Chief Jeber,
verses.36:41: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Phines,
verses.36:42: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mazar,
verses.36:43: Chief Metodiel, Chief Zaphoei. These are the chiefs of Edom in the built-up settlements in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of Edom.
verses.37:1: Now Jacob dwelt in the land where his father had sojourned, in the land of Canaan. And these are the generations of Jacob.
verses.37:2: Joseph, being seventeen years old, was shepherding the sheep with his brethren, being a youth, with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives; and they brought an evil report against Joseph to Israel their father.
verses.37:3: Now Jacob loved Joseph above all his sons, because he was the son of his old age; and he made him a tunic of many colors.
verses.37:4: And when his brethren saw that his father loved him more than all his sons, they hated him and could not speak anything peaceable to him.
verses.37:5: Now Joseph dreamed a dream and told it to his brethren.
verses.37:6: And he said to them, "Hear this dream which I have dreamed.
verses.37:7: I thought that you were binding sheaves in the midst of the field, and my sheaf arose and stood upright; and your sheaves turned around and bowed down to my sheaf."
verses.37:8: And his brethren said to him, "Shall you indeed reign as king over us, or shall you indeed have dominion over us?" And they hated him yet the more because of his dreams and because of his words.
verses.37:9: Then he saw another dream, and recounted it to his father and to his brethren, and said, "Behold, I have dreamed another dream: it was as though the sun and the moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me."
verses.37:10: And his father rebuked him and said, "What is this dream that you have dreamed? Shall we indeed come—both I and your mother and your brethren—to bow down to you to the earth?"
verses.37:11: And his brethren envied him, but his father kept the word.
verses.37:12: Now his brethren went to pasture their father's sheep in Shechem.
verses.37:13: And Israel said to Joseph, "Are not your brethren shepherding in Shechem? Come, let me send you to them." And he said to him, "Behold, here I am."
verses.37:14: And Israel said to him, "Go and see whether your brethren and the sheep are well, and bring back word to me." So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.37:15: And a man found him wandering in the field; and the man asked him, saying, "What do you seek?"
verses.37:16: And he said, "I seek my brethren; tell me where they are pasturing."
verses.37:17: And the man said to him, "They have departed from here; for I heard them saying, 'Let us go to Dothan.'" So Joseph went after his brethren and found them at Dothan.
verses.37:18: Now they saw him from afar before he drew near to them, and they went to slay him.
verses.37:19: And each said to his brother, "Behold, that dreamer is coming.
verses.37:20: Now therefore, come, let us slay him and cast him into one of the pits, and we shall say, 'An evil wild beast has devoured him.' And we shall see what his dreams are."
verses.37:21: But when Reuben heard it, he delivered him out of their hands and said, "We shall not strike him to take his life."
verses.37:22: And Reuben said to them, "Do not shed blood, but cast him into one of the pits that are in the wilderness, and do not lay a hand on him"—that he might deliver him out of their hands and restore him to his father.
verses.37:23: And it came to pass, when Joseph came to his brethren, that they stripped Joseph of the tunic of many colors that was upon him,
verses.37:24: and they took him and cast him into the pit; and that pit had no water.
verses.37:25: Then they sat down to eat bread; and lifting up their eyes they looked, and behold, Ishmaelite travelers were coming from Gilead, and their camels were laden with incense, resin, and myrrh, and they were going to carry them down to Egypt.
verses.37:26: And Judah said to his brethren, "What profit is it if we slay our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.37:27: Come, let us sell him to these Ishmaelites, and do not let our hands be upon him, for he is our brother and our flesh." And his brethren listened.
